```sql
WITH prepared AS (
    -- Scope the meter_readings rows
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        CONCAT(quality, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS quality_ref,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(quality), ' ', '_')) AS quality_slug
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE kwh <= 90.6
),
joined_site AS (
    -- Join sites
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.kwh,
        s.quality,
        s.quality_ref,
        s.quality_slug,
        si.zone AS site_zone
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
    WHERE si.zone = 'Z3'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        quality_ref,
        site_zone,
        ROUND(kwh - AVG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_zone), 2) AS kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_zone) OVER w_site_id) AS distinct_site_zone_in_site_id,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY kwh DESC, id), 3) AS kwh_percent_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_zone) AS rows_in_quality_site_zone,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY kwh DESC, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at,
        ROUND(kwh - AVG(kwh) OVER w_site_id, 2) AS kwh_vs_site_id_avg,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id) AS rows_in_site_id
    FROM joined_site
    WINDOW w_site_id AS (PARTITION BY site_id), w_quality_site_zone AS (PARTITION BY quality, site_zone)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_id) OVER (PARTITION BY site_zone, distinct_site_zone_in_site_id)) AS distinct_site_id_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY site_zone, distinct_site_zone_in_site_id) AS rows_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone_in_site_id,
        LEAD(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_zone ORDER BY kwh_percent_rank ASC, id) AS next_read_at,
        LAG(kwh_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, distinct_site_zone_in_site_id ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_kwh_percent_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY kwh_vs_site_id_avg ASC), 3) AS kwh_vs_site_id_avg_percent_rank
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    read_at,
    kwh,
    quality,
    site_zone,
    kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg,
    distinct_site_zone_in_site_id,
    kwh_percent_rank,
    rows_in_quality_site_zone,
    kwh_vs_site_id_avg,
    rows_in_site_id,
    distinct_site_id_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone,
    rows_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone_in_site_id,
    prev_kwh_percent_rank,
    kwh_vs_site_id_avg_percent_rank
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY rows_in_site_id, kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("kwh") <= 90.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("quality")), " ", "_")).alias("quality_slug"),
    )
)

joined_site = (
    prepared.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("si.zone") == "Z3")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.quality",
        "s.quality_ref",
        "s.quality_slug",
        F.col("si.zone").alias("site_zone"),
    )
)

w_site_id = Window.partitionBy("site_id")
ranked = (
    joined_site
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        "quality_ref",
        "site_zone",
        F.round(F.col("kwh") - F.avg("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_zone")), 2).alias("kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_zone").over(w_site_id)).alias("distinct_site_zone_in_site_id"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("kwh").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("kwh_percent_rank"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_zone")).alias("rows_in_quality_site_zone"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("kwh").desc(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh") - F.avg("kwh").over(w_site_id), 2).alias("kwh_vs_site_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")).alias("rows_in_site_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_id").over(Window.partitionBy("site_zone", "distinct_site_zone_in_site_id"))).alias("distinct_site_id_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("site_zone", "distinct_site_zone_in_site_id")).alias("rows_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone_in_site_id"),
        F.lead("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_zone").orderBy("kwh_percent_rank", "id")).alias("next_read_at"),
        F.lag("kwh_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "distinct_site_zone_in_site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("prev_kwh_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("kwh_vs_site_id_avg")), 3).alias("kwh_vs_site_id_avg_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        "site_zone",
        "kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg",
        "distinct_site_zone_in_site_id",
        "kwh_percent_rank",
        "rows_in_quality_site_zone",
        "kwh_vs_site_id_avg",
        "rows_in_site_id",
        "distinct_site_id_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone",
        "rows_in_site_zone_distinct_site_zone_in_site_id",
        "prev_kwh_percent_rank",
        "kwh_vs_site_id_avg_percent_rank",
    )
    .orderBy("rows_in_site_id", F.col("kwh_vs_quality_site_zone_avg").desc(), "id")
    .limit(20)
)
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Claims that fall inside the policy coverage period
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.policy_id,
        c.claim_date,
        c.claimed_amount,
        c.status,
        c.claim_type,
        p.product,
        p.premium
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p
      ON p.id = c.policy_id
     AND c.claim_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND COALESCE(p.end_date, DATE '2099-12-31')
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(premium * 1.1, 2) AS premium_adj
    FROM covered
    WHERE claim_date >= DATE '2024-08-18'
),
product_stats AS (
    -- Max premium_adj per product
    SELECT product, MAX(premium_adj) AS max_premium_adj
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY product
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_premium_adj,
        ROUND(s.premium_adj - g.max_premium_adj, 2) AS premium_adj_minus_max
    FROM scored s
    JOIN product_stats g ON g.product = s.product
    WHERE s.premium_adj = g.max_premium_adj
)
SELECT
    id,
    policy_id,
    claim_date,
    claimed_amount,
    status,
    claim_type,
    premium_adj,
    premium_adj_minus_max,
    LENGTH(TRIM(status)) AS status_len,
    CASE WHEN premium_adj >= 5310.0 THEN 'A' WHEN premium_adj >= 2025.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS premium_adj_tier
FROM compared
WHERE premium BETWEEN 986.9 AND 4688.7
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

covered = (
    df_claims.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_policies.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.id") == F.col("c.policy_id"))
        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "c.id",
        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",
        "c.claimed_amount",
        "c.status",
        "c.claim_type",
        "p.product",
        "p.premium",
    )
)

scored = (
    covered
    .filter(F.col("claim_date") >= F.lit("2024-08-18").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("premium_adj", F.round(F.col("premium") * 1.1, 2))
)

product_stats = (
    scored
    .groupBy("product")
    .agg(F.max("premium_adj").alias("max_premium_adj"))
)

compared = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(product_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.product") == F.col("s.product"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.premium_adj") == F.col("g.max_premium_adj"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_premium_adj",
        F.round(F.col("s.premium_adj") - F.col("g.max_premium_adj"), 2).alias("premium_adj_minus_max"),
    )
)

result = (
    compared
    .filter(F.col("premium").between(986.9, 4688.7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claimed_amount",
        "status",
        "claim_type",
        "premium_adj",
        "premium_adj_minus_max",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("status"))).alias("status_len"),
        F.when(F.col("premium_adj") >= 5310.0, "A").when(F.col("premium_adj") >= 2025.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("premium_adj_tier"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH valid_plays AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        device,
        MONTH(played_at) AS played_at_month
    FROM plays
    WHERE listener_id IS NOT NULL
      AND is_skipped = TRUE
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(played_at_month / NULLIF(SUM(played_at_month) OVER w_track_id_played_at_month, 0), 4) AS played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont,
        ROUND(AVG(ms_played) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id, played_at_month), 2) AS track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY played_at_month DESC, id) AS played_at_month_dense_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(listener_id) OVER w_track_id_played_at_month) AS distinct_listener_id_in_track_id_played_at_month,
        MAX(ms_played) OVER w_track_id_played_at_month AS track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played,
        LAG(ms_played, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY ms_played NULLS LAST, id) AS prev_ms_played,
        ROUND(AVG(ms_played) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id, device ORDER BY played_at_month DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ms_played_avg_3,
        SUM(ms_played) OVER w_track_id_played_at_month AS track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played
    FROM valid_plays
    WINDOW w_track_id_played_at_month AS (PARTITION BY track_id, played_at_month)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        track_id,
        ms_played,
        device,
        played_at_month,
        played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont,
        track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played,
        track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played,
        prev_ms_played,
        ms_played_avg_3,
        track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY played_at, id) AS played_at_decile,
        prev_ms_played - LAG(prev_ms_played) OVER (ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_ms_played_change,
        ROUND(played_at_month - AVG(played_at_month) OVER (PARTITION BY played_at_month, track_id), 2) AS played_at_month_vs_played_at_month_track_id_avg,
        SUM(played_at_month) OVER (PARTITION BY played_at_month ORDER BY played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS played_at_month_sum_3_prior,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_played_at_month_by_played_at_2 AS played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont_2
    FROM sequenced
    WINDOW w_played_at_month_by_played_at_2 AS (PARTITION BY played_at_month ORDER BY played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont DESC, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    track_id,
    ms_played,
    device,
    played_at_month,
    track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played,
    track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played,
    prev_ms_played,
    ms_played_avg_3,
    track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played,
    prev_ms_played_change,
    played_at_month_vs_played_at_month_track_id_avg,
    played_at_month_sum_3_prior
FROM metrics
WHERE prev_ms_played > 42041
ORDER BY ms_played, played_at_month_sum_3_prior
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter((F.col("listener_id").isNotNull()) & (F.col("is_skipped")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        F.month(F.col("played_at")).alias("played_at_month"),
    )
)

w_track_id_played_at_month = Window.partitionBy("track_id", "played_at_month")
sequenced = (
    valid_plays
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("played_at_month") / F.nullif(F.sum("played_at_month").over(w_track_id_played_at_month), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont"),
        F.round(F.avg("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id", "played_at_month")), 2).alias("track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("played_at_month").desc(), "id")).alias("played_at_month_dense_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("listener_id").over(w_track_id_played_at_month)).alias("distinct_listener_id_in_track_id_played_at_month"),
        F.max("ms_played").over(w_track_id_played_at_month).alias("track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played"),
        F.lag("ms_played", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("prev_ms_played"),
        F.round(F.avg("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "device").orderBy(F.col("played_at_month").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("ms_played_avg_3"),
        F.sum("ms_played").over(w_track_id_played_at_month).alias("track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played"),
    )
)

w_played_at_month_by_played_at_2 = Window.partitionBy("played_at_month").orderBy(F.col("played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont").desc(), "id")
metrics = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "id",
        "track_id",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "played_at_month",
        "played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont",
        "track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played",
        "track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played",
        "prev_ms_played",
        "ms_played_avg_3",
        "track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy("played_at", "id")).alias("played_at_decile"),
        (F.col("prev_ms_played") - F.lag("prev_ms_played").over(Window.orderBy("played_at", "id"))).alias("prev_ms_played_change"),
        F.round(F.col("played_at_month") - F.avg("played_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("played_at_month", "track_id")), 2).alias("played_at_month_vs_played_at_month_track_id_avg"),
        F.sum("played_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("played_at_month").orderBy(F.col("played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("played_at_month_sum_3_prior"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_played_at_month_by_played_at_2).alias("played_at_month_share_of_track_id_played_at_mont_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("prev_ms_played") > 42041)
    .select(
        "id",
        "track_id",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "played_at_month",
        "track_id_played_at_month_avg_ms_played",
        "track_id_played_at_month_max_ms_played",
        "prev_ms_played",
        "ms_played_avg_3",
        "track_id_played_at_month_sum_ms_played",
        "prev_ms_played_change",
        "played_at_month_vs_played_at_month_track_id_avg",
        "played_at_month_sum_3_prior",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("ms_played").asc(), "played_at_month_sum_3_prior")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("ms_played") < 287769)
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "is_skipped",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("device")), 1, 2).alias("device_prefix"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("device")), 1, 2).alias("device_prefix_2"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    valid_plays
    .filter(F.col("listener_id") <= 11)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format(F.col("played_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("played_at_label"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    annotated
    .filter(F.col("device_prefix").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(
        "listener_id",
        F.year("played_at").alias("played_at_year"),
        F.when(F.col("ms_played") >= 223828, "A").when(F.col("ms_played") >= 129336, "B").otherwise("C").alias("ms_played_tier"),

    .agg(

    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)

result = (

    .groupBy("listener_id")
```

```sql
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.policy_id,

        c.approved_amount,
        c.adjuster_id,
        p.product,

),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(premium) OVER (PARTITION BY product, adjuster_id ORDER BY premium, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_premium,
        SUM(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product, adjuster_id ORDER BY premium, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS approved_amount_sum_1_prior,
        SUM(premium) OVER (ORDER BY claim_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS premium_sum_4,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product, adjuster_id ORDER BY premium, id) AS premium_rank
    FROM in_window
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date), premium_rank ORDER BY claimed_amount ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS claimed_amount_max_1_prior,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_approved_amount AS approved_amount_rank,
        MAX(claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product) AS product_max_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_claim_date_month_premium_ran_2, 3) AS claimed_amount_percent_rank,
        SUM(premium) OVER w_product AS product_sum_premium,
        FIRST_VALUE(premium) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_premium
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_all_by_approved_amount AS (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id), w_claim_date_month_premium_ran_2 AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date), premium_rank ORDER BY claimed_amount ASC), w_product AS (PARTITION BY product)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    claim_date,
    claimed_amount,
    approved_amount,
    adjuster_id,
    product,
    premium,
    premium_sum_4,
    approved_amount_rank,
    product_max_claimed_amount,
    claimed_amount_percent_rank,
    product_sum_premium,
    first_known_premium,
    DATE_ADD(claim_date, 7) AS claim_date_plus_7d,

FROM ranked
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_claims.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_policies.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.id") == F.col("c.policy_id"))
        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "c.id",
        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",
        "c.claimed_amount",
        "c.approved_amount",
        "c.adjuster_id",
        "p.product",
        "p.premium",
    )
)

metrics = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("product", "adjuster_id").orderBy("premium", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_premium"),
        F.sum("approved_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("product", "adjuster_id").orderBy("premium", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("approved_amount_sum_1_prior"),
        F.sum("premium").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("claim_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("premium_sum_4"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("product", "adjuster_id").orderBy("premium", "id")).alias("premium_rank"),
    )
)

w_claim_date_month_premium_ran_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date"), "premium_rank").orderBy("claimed_amount")
w_product = Window.partitionBy("product")
ranked = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date"), "premium_rank").orderBy("claimed_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("claimed_amount_max_1_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w_all_by_approved_amount).alias("approved_amount_rank"),
        F.max("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("product")).alias("product_max_claimed_amount"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_claim_date_month_premium_ran_2), 3).alias("claimed_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("premium").over(w_product).alias("product_sum_premium"),
        F.first("premium", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_premium"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(

        "claim_date",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "adjuster_id",
        "product",

        "product_max_claimed_amount",

        "product_sum_premium",
        "first_known_premium",
        F.date_add(F.col("claim_date"), 7).alias("claim_date_plus_7d"),
        F.round(F.col("claimed_amount") / F.nullif(F.col("premium"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("claimed_amount_per_premium"),
```

```sql
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags,

priority_stats AS (
    -- Avg requester_id per priority
    SELECT priority, AVG(requester_id) AS avg_requester_id
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY priority
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_requester_id,
        ROUND(s.requester_id - g.avg_requester_id, 2) AS requester_id_minus_avg
    FROM recent s
    JOIN priority_stats g ON g.priority = s.priority
    WHERE s.requester_id > g.avg_requester_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows that have matching tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM outliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tickets t
            WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id
              AND t.priority = 'P1'
              AND t.channel = 'web'
        )
      AND s.opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-06 10:00:00'
),
with_children_events AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.tags,
        t.id AS event_id,
        t.actor AS event_actor,
        t.event_at
    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.id AND t.event_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-24 10:00:00'

flattened AS (

)

    tag_pos,
```

```python
windowed = (
```

```python
with_windows = (

        (F.col("ms_played") - F.lag("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "source").orderBy("played_at", "id"))).alias("ms_played_change"),
        F.first("ms_played_filled", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_ms_played_filled"),
        F.lead("ms_played_filled", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_ms_played_filled"),
    )
)

per_group = (

    .groupBy("is_skipped", "source")

        F.min("ms_played").alias("min_ms_played"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & (~F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/cart"))))
    .withColumn("event_type_upper", F.upper("event_type"))
    .withColumn("page_group", F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/cart", "/search"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other"))
)

prev_events = base.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "page_group",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("island_id"),

)

result = (
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

)
```

```sql
    -- Running and moving aggregates
```

```sql
        ROUND(AVG(prior_rows_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d, agent_id), 2) AS prior_rows_1d_agent_id_avg_prior_rows_1d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_prior_rows_1d_agent_id_by_pr, 3) AS prior_rows_1d_cume_dist
    FROM matched

enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns

        *,
        ROUND(prior_csat_1d / NULLIF(prior_rows_1d_cume_dist, 0), 3) AS prior_csat_1d_per_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist,

        t.first_event_at
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN event_stats t ON t.ticket_id = s.id
)
SELECT
    agent_id,
    event_count,
    prior_rows_1d_filled,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    ROUND(AVG(prior_csat_1d_per_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_prior_csat_1d_per_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_rows_1d_cume_dist, 0.5) AS median_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist
```

```python
        "product",

)
```

```python
    scoped_policys
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("product").orderBy("premium_filled")).alias("premium_filled_dense_rank"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "product")).alias("rows_in_end_date_year_product"),
    )
)

top_per_group = (
    sequenced
    .filter((F.col("premium_filled_dense_rank") == 1) & (F.col("premium_filled") < 3560.0))
)

screened = (

    .crossJoin(top_per_group.agg(F.avg("rows_in_end_date_year_product").alias("overall_avg_rows_in_end_date_year_product")))
    .filter(F.col("rows_in_end_date_year_product") > F.col("overall_avg_rows_in_end_date_year_product"))

windowed = (
```

```sql
        c.id,
```

```sql
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
joined_policy AS (

    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN product IN ('AUTO', 'LIFE') THEN 'group_a' WHEN product = 'TRAVEL' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS product_group,

        CONCAT_WS('-', claim_type, policy_product) AS claim_type_policy_product_label
    FROM joined_policy
)

FROM annotated
```

```sql
        prior_rows_12h - LAG(prior_rows_12h) OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prior_rows_12h_change,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at), 3) AS enrolled_at_cume_dist
    FROM in_window
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_12h_change per student_id
    SELECT student_id, AVG(prior_rows_12h_change) AS avg_prior_rows_12h_change
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY student_id
),
compared AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h_change - g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change, 2) AS prior_rows_12h_change_minus_avg
    FROM metrics s

    prior_rows_12h_change,
    prior_rows_12h_change_minus_avg,

FROM compared
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN merchant = '7-Eleven' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_7_eleven,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'NONE') resolved_merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS DISTINCT FROM 'Lazada'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS prev_txn_time
    FROM cleaned
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type, account_id
    FROM sessionized
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT txn_type, account_id
    FROM transactions
    WHERE amount < 1400
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessionized s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type AND s.account_id = k.account_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        a.status,
        a.balance
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN accounts a
        ON s.account_id = a.id
    WHERE a.balance BETWEEN 23000 AND 77000
),
cleaned_transactions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        is_7_eleven,
        prev_txn_time,
        is_new_burst,
        session_no,
        balance,
        CASE WHEN is_flagged THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END is_flagged_label,
        COALESCE(balance, 0) balance_filled
    FROM joined
    WHERE is_new_burst IS NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        a.account_type,
        a.status
    FROM cleaned_transactions src
    LEFT JOIN accounts a
        ON src.account_id = a.id
),
joined_transactions AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_id,
        s.amount,
        s.txn_time,
        s.merchant,
        s.is_new_burst,
        s.session_no,
        s.balance,
        s.balance_filled,
        s.status,
        d.account_type AS account_account_type,
        d.opened_date
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN accounts d
        ON s.account_id = d.id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    ROUND(SUM(e.balance), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(AVG(e.session_no), 2) AS avg_session_no,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM joined_transactions e
INNER JOIN accounts d ON e.account_id = d.id
GROUP BY CUBE (d.account_type, d.status)
ORDER BY total_balance NULLS LAST;
```

```sql
sequenced AS (

        ROUND(total_csat / NULLIF(SUM(total_csat) OVER w_channel_len, 0), 4) AS total_csat_share_of_channel_len,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(priority) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_len)) AS distinct_priority_in_channel_len,
        LAST_VALUE(channel_len) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY median_channel_len, channel_len ORDER BY median_channel_len, priority, channel, channel_len ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel_len
    FROM stats
    WINDOW w_n_priority_p2_by_median_chan AS (PARTITION BY n_priority_p2 ORDER BY median_channel_len, priority, channel, channel_len), w_all_by_median_channel_len AS (ORDER BY median_channel_len NULLS LAST, priority, channel, channel_len), w_channel_len AS (PARTITION BY channel_len)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_tickets
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.when(F.col("requester_id") >= 21, "A").when(F.col("requester_id") >= 11, "B").otherwise("C").alias("requester_id_tier"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("channel"))).alias("channel_len"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("priority")), " ", "_")).alias("priority_slug"),
    )
)

stats = (
    prepared
    .groupBy("priority", "channel", "channel_len")
    .agg(
        F.sum("csat").alias("total_csat"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("priority") == "P2", 1)).alias("n_priority_p2"),
        F.percentile_approx("channel_len", 0.5).alias("median_channel_len"),
    )
)

w_n_priority_p2_by_median_chan = Window.partitionBy("n_priority_p2").orderBy("median_channel_len", "priority", "channel", "channel_len")
w_all_by_median_channel_len = Window.orderBy(F.col("median_channel_len").asc_nulls_last(), "priority", "channel", "channel_len")
w_channel_len = Window.partitionBy("channel_len")
sequenced = (
    stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w_n_priority_p2_by_median_chan).alias("rn"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_median_channel_len).alias("median_channel_len_seq"),
        F.round(F.col("total_csat") / F.nullif(F.sum("total_csat").over(w_channel_len), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("total_csat_share_of_channel_len"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("priority").over(Window.partitionBy("channel_len"))).alias("distinct_priority_in_channel_len"),
        F.last("channel_len", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("median_channel_len", "channel_len").orderBy("median_channel_len", "priority", "channel", "channel_len").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_channel_len"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("n_priority_p2") > 2)
    .select(
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "channel_len",
        "total_csat",
        "n_priority_p2",
        "median_channel_len",
        "rn",
        "median_channel_len_seq",
        "total_csat_share_of_channel_len",
```

```sql
    FROM joined

gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session

    FROM with_prev

islands AS (

        last_restock_period,

    FROM islands

ranked AS (
```

```python
        "quality",
```

```python
        F.round(F.avg("qty_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("operator", "move_type").orderBy(F.col("moved_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("qty_bucket_avg_7"),
```

```python
        F.quarter(F.col("end_date")).alias("end_date_quarter"),
    )
)

w_end_date_quarter_status = Window.partitionBy("end_date_quarter", "status")
windowed = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("holder_id").over(w_end_date_quarter_status)).alias("distinct_holder_id_in_end_date_quarter_status"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date_quarter", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("premium_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("product").over(Window.partitionBy("end_date_quarter", "status"))).alias("distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status"),
        F.first("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date_quarter", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_premium"),
        F.min("premium_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("end_date_quarter", "status")).alias("end_date_quarter_status_min_premium_bucket"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("end_date_quarter", "id")), 3).alias("end_date_quarter_percent_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_holder = (
    windowed.alias("s")
    .join(df_policyholders.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.holder_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.holder_id",
        "s.product",
        "s.premium",
        "s.status",
        "s.premium_bucket",
        "s.end_date_quarter",
        "s.distinct_holder_id_in_end_date_quarter_status",
        "s.premium_bucket_avg_2",
        "s.distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status",
        "s.first_premium",
        "s.end_date_quarter_status_min_premium_bucket",
        "s.end_date_quarter_percent_rank",
        F.col("p.region").alias("holder_region"),
        F.col("p.risk_score").alias("holder_risk_score"),
        "p.holder_name",
    )
)

product_stats = (
    enriched_holder
    .groupBy("product")
    .agg(F.avg("premium_bucket_avg_2").alias("avg_premium_bucket_avg_2"))

above_average = (

    .join(product_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.product") == F.col("s.product"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.premium_bucket_avg_2") > F.col("g.avg_premium_bucket_avg_2"))
    .select(

        "g.avg_premium_bucket_avg_2",
        F.round(F.col("s.premium_bucket_avg_2") - F.col("g.avg_premium_bucket_avg_2"), 2).alias("premium_bucket_avg_2_minus_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    above_average
    .groupingSets(
        [["distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status", "holder_id"], ["distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status"], []],
        "distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status", "holder_id",

        F.round(F.stddev("premium_bucket_avg_2_minus_avg"), 2).alias("stddev_premium_bucket_avg_2_minus_avg"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("distinct_product_in_end_date_quarter_status").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```sql
        SUM(unit_price) AS session_unit_price,
```

```sql
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,

      ON b.site_id = a.site_id

    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at

    -- Keep the earliest row per site_id
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        prior_rows_3d,
        prior_kwh_3d
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY prior_rows_3d, id) AS rn
        FROM matched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
exploded_detail_readings AS (
    -- One row per reading
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.prior_rows_3d,
        m.id AS reading_id,
        m.quality AS reading_quality,
        m.kwh AS reading_kwh
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN meter_readings m ON m.site_id = s.site_id AND m.quality = 'OK'
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT SUM(m.kwh) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS total_reading_kwh
    FROM exploded_detail_readings s
)
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    reading_id,
    reading_quality,
    reading_kwh
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_meter_readings.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_meter_readings.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.kwh").alias("prior_kwh_3d"),
    )
)

)
```

```python
    .filter(~F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("store")))
    .select(

    .select("customer_id", "status")

    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

        "discount",

        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("discount_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("x"), (F.col("x.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.paid_at") < F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

kept_keys_2 = (
    not_flagged
    .select("customer_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("amount") >= 1380)
        .select("customer_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

daily = (
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        status,
        INITCAP(TRIM(product)) AS product_clean,
        INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS status_clean,
        DATE_FORMAT(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date_label
    FROM policies
    WHERE premium <= 4670.9
      AND start_date < DATE '2025-03-21'
),
policy_stats AS (
    -- Per-holder policies metrics
    SELECT holder_id, COUNT(*) AS policy_count, COUNT(*) AS policy_count_2
    FROM policies
    GROUP BY holder_id
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach policies metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(p.policy_count, 0) AS policy_count,
        COALESCE(p.policy_count_2, 0) AS policy_count_2
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN policy_stats p ON p.holder_id = s.holder_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching policies
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_counts s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM policies p
            WHERE p.holder_id = s.holder_id
              AND p.start_date < DATE '2025-02-14'
              AND p.status IN ('EXPIRED', 'ACTIVE')
        )
      AND s.start_date_label IS NOT NULL
),
joined_holder AS (
    -- Join policyholders
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.holder_id,
        s.product,
        s.premium,
        s.start_date,
        s.status,
        s.product_clean,
        s.policy_count,
        s.policy_count_2,
        p.region AS holder_region,
        p.holder_name
    FROM without_matches s
    LEFT JOIN policyholders p ON p.id = s.holder_id AND p.risk_score < 0.8
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        status,
        product_clean,
        policy_count,
        holder_region,
        holder_name,
        LEAD(start_date, 3) OVER w_status_policy_count_by_premi AS next3_start_date,
        NTH_VALUE(start_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY status, policy_count ORDER BY premium DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_start_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date), holder_id ORDER BY policy_count_2 ASC, id) AS rn,
        ROUND(policy_count / NULLIF(SUM(policy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY product), 0), 4) AS policy_count_share_of_product,
        LAG(policy_count_2) OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id, status ORDER BY policy_count DESC, id) AS prev_policy_count_2,
        MAX(premium) OVER (PARTITION BY status, policy_count ORDER BY premium DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS premium_max_3_prior
    FROM joined_holder
    WINDOW w_status_policy_count_by_premi AS (PARTITION BY status, policy_count ORDER BY premium DESC, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    holder_id,
    product,
    premium,
    start_date,
    product_clean,
    policy_count,
    holder_region,
    holder_name,
    rn,
    policy_count_share_of_product,
    prev_policy_count_2,
    premium_max_3_prior,
    CONCAT(holder_name, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS holder_name_ref
FROM sequenced
WHERE LOWER(holder_name) LIKE '%no%'
ORDER BY start_date NULLS LAST, prev_policy_count_2 NULLS LAST
```

```sql
),
```
```sql
labeled AS (
```
```sql
    -- Derive helper columns
```

```sql
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', end_date_month) AS end_date_month_week
    FROM rollup_base
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,

        SUM(b.unit_price) AS prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM stock_moves a
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per sku_id
    SELECT
        id,
        sku_id,
        moved_at,
        prior_rows_1d,
        prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id ORDER BY prior_unit_price_1d, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        sku_id,
        prior_rows_1d,
        MAX(moved_at) AS last_moved_at,
        MIN(moved_at) AS first_moved_at,
        SUM(prior_rows_1d) AS total_prior_rows_1d,
        MAX(prior_unit_price_1d) AS max_prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM deduped
```

```python
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-04-23").cast("date")) & F.hour("started_at").between(8, 16))
    .withColumn("browser_upper", F.upper("browser"))
    .withColumn("country_clean", F.coalesce("country", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("device") == "mobile")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_country"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "started_at"), "browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser_upper",
        "country_clean",
        "first_known_country",
        "row_seq",
        F.round((F.col("row_seq") / F.sum("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "started_at"), "browser"))), 4).alias("row_seq_share"),
        F.lag("row_seq", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")).alias("prev_row_seq"),
        F.max("row_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("row_seq_max_7d"),
        F.lag("row_seq", 1).over(w_hist).alias("prev_row_seq_2"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.event_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.device",
        "s.browser_upper",
        "s.row_seq",
        "s.row_seq_share",
        F.col("c.duration_sec").alias("web_event_duration_sec"),
    )

with_windows = (

    .select(
        "id",
```

```sql
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_kwh_tier_by_read_at AS seq_no,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY kwh_tier ORDER BY read_at DESC, id), 3) AS read_at_cume_dist
    FROM derived
    WINDOW w_kwh_tier_by_read_at_ties AS (PARTITION BY kwh_tier ORDER BY read_at DESC), w_kwh_tier_by_read_at AS (PARTITION BY kwh_tier ORDER BY read_at DESC, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    quality,

    kwh_tier,
    read_at_percent_rank,
```

```sql
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups

        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_prior_rows_12h_site_id_by_re_2 AS read_at_dense_rank,

        prior_kwh_12h - LAG(prior_kwh_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h, site_id ORDER BY read_at ASC, id) AS prior_kwh_12h_change
    FROM joined_ranges
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "source",
    )
)

with_prev = base_plays.withColumn("prev_played_at", F.lag("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("source").orderBy("played_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_played_at").isNull() | (F.col("played_at") > F.col("prev_played_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
```

```sql
        ROUND(prior_csat_12h - AVG(prior_csat_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, agent_tier), 2) AS prior_csat_12h_vs_agent_id_agent_tier_avg,

    FROM with_details

        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at_2
```

```sql
    -- Scope the meter_readings rows
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality
    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous read_at per site_id
    SELECT *, LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id) AS prev_read_at
    FROM base_readings
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_read_at IS NULL OR read_at > prev_read_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        voltage - LAG(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY is_new_session ORDER BY kwh DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS voltage_change,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY is_new_session ORDER BY kwh DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_max_4,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY read_at ASC), 3) AS read_at_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY is_new_session ORDER BY kwh DESC NULLS FIRST) AS kwh_dense_rank,
        MIN(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY is_new_session) AS is_new_session_min_burst_id
    FROM sessionized
)
-- Final projection

    site_id,
    kwh,
    voltage,
    quality,
    is_new_session,
    voltage_change,
    read_at_percent_rank,
    kwh_dense_rank,
    CONCAT(quality, '#', CAST(burst_id_max_4 AS STRING)) AS quality_ref,
    COALESCE(read_at_percent_rank, 0.0) AS read_at_percent_rank_filled
FROM with_trends
```

```sql
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),

    -- Max prior_kwh_7d per site_id
    SELECT site_id, MAX(prior_kwh_7d) AS max_prior_kwh_7d
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY site_id

above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_prior_kwh_7d,
```

```python
        "valid_to",
        "rate",

        F.sum("rate").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("valid_to")).orderBy("valid_to", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_rate"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,

        r.voltage,
        st.zone,

    SELECT site_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(energy_cost, 0.5) AS median_energy_cost
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY site_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_energy_cost,
        ROUND(s.energy_cost - g.median_energy_cost, 2) AS energy_cost_minus_median
    FROM in_window s

screened AS (

    FROM outliers

grouped AS (
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("r")
    .join(df_sites.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        df_tariff_windows.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "r.id",
        "r.site_id",
        "r.read_at",
        "r.kwh",
        "r.voltage",

site_id_stats = (

    .groupBy("site_id")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("event_type"))).alias("event_type_len"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),

    .drop("sum_session_event_type_len_check")
)

screened = (
    grouped
    .crossJoin(grouped.agg(F.avg("total_duration_min").alias("overall_avg_total_duration_min")))
    .filter(F.col("total_duration_min") > F.col("overall_avg_total_duration_min"))
    .drop("overall_avg_total_duration_min")
)

result = (
    screened
    .select(
        "event_type",
        "total_duration_min",
        "n_rows",
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(ms_played) AS session_ms_played,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

        session_end,

    FROM session_summary

)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id AS entity_id,
        capacity,
        opened_on AS day,
        'warehouse' AS src

    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(wh_code)) LIKE 'K%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        id,
        capacity,
        opened_on,
        'warehouse_2' AS src
    FROM warehouses
    WHERE YEAR(opened_on) = 2024
      AND capacity > 2614
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        capacity,
        id,
        opened_on,
        'warehouse_3' AS src
    FROM warehouses
)

GROUP BY src
ORDER BY src
```

```python
    df_warehouses
    .filter(F.upper(F.trim(F.col("wh_code"))).like("K%"))

        F.col("id").alias("entity_id"),
        "capacity",
        F.col("opened_on").alias("day"),
        F.lit("warehouse").alias("src"),
    )
)

warehouse_rows = (

    .filter((F.year(F.col("opened_on")) == 2024) & (F.col("capacity") > 2614))
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.speaker_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.phone_count, 0) AS speaker_count_minus_phone_count
```

```sql
        FIRST_VALUE(approved_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, MONTH(claim_date) ORDER BY claimed_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_approved_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, MONTH(claim_date) ORDER BY claimed_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS approved_amount_avg_4
    FROM filtered

),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns

    WHERE policy_id IS NOT NULL

screened AS (

stats AS (

        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS distinct_status
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(claim_date, 'yyyy-MM')
),
flattened AS (
    -- One row per status_list_item
    SELECT
        s.claim_date_ym,

        s.avg_rows_in_adjuster_id_policy_id,
        s.n_rows,
```

```python
w_course_id_grade_status = Window.partitionBy("course_id", "grade_status")
```

```python
        F.sum("kwh").over(w_site_id_site_tariff).alias("site_id_site_tariff_sum_kwh"),
```

```sql
    FROM tickets

    -- Previous opened_at per priority
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM base_tickets

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        priority,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(requester_id_minus_csat) AS session_requester_id_minus_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY priority, burst_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        priority,
        burst_id,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        events,
        session_requester_id_minus_csat,
        TO_DATE(session_start) AS session_start_date
    FROM sessions
    WHERE session_end >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-21 09:00:00'
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(priority) OVER (PARTITION BY events, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start))) AS distinct_priority_in_events_session_start_month,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY session_end DESC, priority, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY session_end DESC, priority, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS burst_id_max_2_prior,
        NTH_VALUE(session_start_date, 2) OVER (ORDER BY session_end DESC, priority, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_session_start_date
    FROM annotated
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS

    priority,
    burst_id,
```

```python
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        (F.col("requester_id") - F.col("csat")).alias("requester_id_minus_csat"),
    )
)

with_prev = base_tickets.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("priority", "burst_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("opened_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("requester_id_minus_csat").alias("session_requester_id_minus_csat"),

        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        "session_requester_id_minus_csat",
        F.to_date(F.col("session_start")).alias("session_start_date"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("priority").over(Window.partitionBy("events", F.date_trunc("month", "session_start")))).alias("distinct_priority_in_events_session_start_month"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("session_end").desc(), "priority", "burst_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.max("burst_id").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("session_end").desc(), "priority", "burst_id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("burst_id_max_2_prior"),
```

```sql
        device,
        is_skipped,
        source,
        CASE WHEN ms_played >= 299017 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ms_played >= 72464 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS ms_played_tier
    FROM plays
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous played_at per source
    SELECT *, LAG(played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_played_at
    FROM valid_plays
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(played_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_played_at)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        source,
        burst_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY source, burst_id
)
SELECT
    source,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    duration_min,
    QUARTER(session_start) AS session_start_quarter
FROM session_summary
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.car_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.desktop_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```python
w_grade_status_by_enrolled_at = Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")
w_all_by_course_credits = Window.orderBy(F.col("course_credits").desc(), "id")

        F.rank().over(w_grade_status_by_enrolled_at).alias("enrolled_at_rank"),
        F.lag("enrolled_at").over(w_all_by_course_credits).alias("prev_enrolled_at"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("enrolled_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_enrolled_at"),
        (F.col("course_credits") - F.lag("course_credits").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("course_credits").desc(), "id"))).alias("course_credits_change"),
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
```

```python
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
        F.quarter(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_quarter"),

)

    base.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")

    )
)

w_site_zone_quality_by_voltage = Window.partitionBy("site_zone", "quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")
w_site_commissioned_on_year_by = Window.partitionBy(F.year("site_commissioned_on")).orderBy("voltage", "id")
```

```sql
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(st.move_count, 0) AS move_count,
        st.first_moved_at
    FROM joined_ranges s
    LEFT JOIN move_stats st ON st.sku_id = s.sku_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        moved_at,
        prior_rows_3d,
        prior_unit_price_3d,
        first_moved_at,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', first_moved_at) AS days_since_first_moved_at
    FROM summarized_rows
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    WHERE prior_rows_3d > (SELECT MIN(prior_rows_3d) FROM scored)
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_3d"),
    )
)

move_stats = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        approved_amount,
        status,
        reported_at,
        CASE WHEN approved_amount >= 20880.4 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN approved_amount >= 2272.7 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS approved_amount_tier,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', claim_type, status) AS claim_type_status_label
    FROM claims
    WHERE claim_type = 'fire'
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN approved_amount >= 19337.6 THEN 'A' WHEN approved_amount >= 0.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS approved_amount_tier_2,
        policy_id,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_status_is_not_null,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(claim_type)) AS claim_type_list,
        MAX(reported_at) AS last_reported_at,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(claim_date), MIN(claim_date)) AS claim_date_span_days
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN approved_amount >= 19337.6 THEN 'A' WHEN approved_amount >= 0.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END, policy_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        approved_amount_tier_2,
        policy_id,
        pct_status_is_not_null,
        claim_type_list,
        last_reported_at,
        claim_date_span_days,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(last_reported_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(last_reported_at) OVER (ORDER BY pct_status_is_not_null NULLS LAST, approved_amount_tier_2, policy_id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_last_reported_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_status_is_not_null NULLS LAST, approved_amount_tier_2, policy_id) AS seq_no
    FROM rollup_base
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach claims metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(c.reported_at) FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS first_claim_reported_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS claim_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.claim_type = 'delay') FROM claims c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS claim_claim_type_count
    FROM ranked s
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT claim_claim_type_count, last_reported_at, approved_amount_tier_2, claim_date_span_days
    FROM with_counts
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(claim_date_span_days) AS total, COUNT(claim_date_span_days) AS n
    FOR approved_amount_tier_2 IN ('C', 'B', 'A')
)
ORDER BY claim_claim_type_count, last_reported_at
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("claim_type") == "fire")
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "approved_amount",
        "status",
        "reported_at",
        F.when(F.col("approved_amount") >= 20880.4, "HIGH").when(F.col("approved_amount") >= 2272.7, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("approved_amount_tier"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("claim_type"), F.col("status")).alias("claim_type_status_label"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("approved_amount") >= 19337.6, "A").when(F.col("approved_amount") >= 0.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("approved_amount_tier_2"),
        "policy_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("status").isNotNull(), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_status_is_not_null"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("claim_type")).alias("claim_type_list"),
        F.max("reported_at").alias("last_reported_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.datediff(F.max("claim_date"), F.min("claim_date")).alias("claim_date_span_days"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "approved_amount_tier_2",
        "policy_id",
        "pct_status_is_not_null",
        "claim_type_list",
        "last_reported_at",
        "claim_date_span_days",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("last_reported_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("last_reported_at").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pct_status_is_not_null").asc_nulls_last(), "approved_amount_tier_2", "policy_id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_last_reported_at"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("pct_status_is_not_null").asc_nulls_last(), "approved_amount_tier_2", "policy_id")).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

claim_stats = (
    df_claims
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("reported_at").alias("first_claim_reported_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("claim_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("claim_type") == "delay", 1)).alias("claim_claim_type_count"),
    )
)

with_counts = (
    ranked.alias("s")
    .join(claim_stats.alias("c"), F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "c.first_claim_reported_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.claim_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("claim_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.claim_claim_type_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("claim_claim_type_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_counts
    .groupBy("claim_claim_type_count", "last_reported_at")
    .pivot("approved_amount_tier_2", ["C", "B", "A"])
    .agg(F.sum("claim_date_span_days").alias("total"), F.count("claim_date_span_days").alias("n"))

)
```

```sql
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at) AS event_at_month, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count

    COALESCE(a.escalated_count, 0) AS escalated_count,
    COALESCE(b.replied_count, 0) AS replied_count,
    COALESCE(a.escalated_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.replied_count, 0) AS escalated_count_minus_replied_count
FROM escalated_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN replied_monthly b
  ON a.event_at_month = b.event_at_month
ORDER BY event_at_month
```

```sql
        SUM(is_flagged_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_is_flagged_flag
```

```python
w_release_date_month_is_explic = Window.partitionBy(F.month("release_date"), "is_explicit")

        (F.col("bpm") - F.lag("bpm").over(w_artist_country_by_bpm)).alias("bpm_change"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_limits) li AS val
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT currency
    FROM lines
    INTERSECT
    SELECT currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency <> 'USD'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM lines s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.currency = k.currency
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        val,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_cume_dist,
        COUNT(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_count_val
    FROM verified
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        val,
        currency_count_val,

        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_count_val DESC) AS currency_count_val_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_count_val DESC NULLS FIRST) AS currency_count_val_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY currency_count_val ASC) AS currency_count_val_cume_dist
    FROM scored
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN currency_count_val_cume_dist >= 0.64 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS currency_count_val_cume_dist_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(currency_count_val_percent_rank, 0.9) AS currency_count_val_percent_rank_p90,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(val, 0.95) AS val_p95,
    MIN(currency_count_val_dense_rank) AS min_currency_count_val_dense_rank
FROM metrics

ORDER BY currency_count_val_cume_dist_tier ASC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("val"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    lines
    .select("currency")
    .intersect(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") != "USD")
        .select("currency")
    )
)

verified = (
    lines
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.currency") == F.col("k.currency")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())).alias("val_cume_dist"),
        F.count("val").over(Window.partitionBy("currency")).alias("currency_count_val"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        "currency_count_val",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_count_val").desc())).alias("currency_count_val_rank"),
```

```sql
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY 1
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM grouped
    WHERE requester_id_channel_phone > (SELECT AVG(requester_id_channel_phone) FROM grouped)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(requester_id_channel_phone) OVER w_last_closed_at_year_distinct, 2) AS last_closed_at_year_distinct_channels_avg_reques,
        LEAD(closed_at_day, 2) OVER (ORDER BY requester_id_channel_phone DESC, closed_at_day) AS next2_closed_at_day
    FROM with_activity
    WINDOW w_last_closed_at_year_distinct AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_closed_at), distinct_channels)
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        closed_at_day,
        requester_id_channel_phone,
        distinct_channels,

    FROM ranked
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg

    FROM scored
    WHERE requester_id_channel_phone > (SELECT AVG(requester_id_channel_phone) FROM scored)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(distinct_channels) OVER (PARTITION BY distinct_channels) AS distinct_channels_min_distinct_channels,
        LAST_VALUE(requester_id_channel_phone) OVER (PARTITION BY distinct_channels ORDER BY distinct_channels ASC, closed_at_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_requester_id_channel_phone,
        MAX(distinct_channels) OVER (PARTITION BY distinct_channels) AS distinct_channels_max_distinct_channels,
        LAG(distinct_channels, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY distinct_channels DESC, closed_at_day) AS prev2_distinct_channels,

    distinct_channels,
```

```python
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("csat") < 4)
    .select(

        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("csat").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("closed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("opened_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_opened_at_to_closed_at"),

ranked = (

        F.lead("closed_at_day", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id_channel_phone").desc(), "closed_at_day")).alias("next2_closed_at_day"),
    )
)

scored = (

    .select(
        "closed_at_day",
        "requester_id_channel_phone",
        "distinct_channels",
```

```sql
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

        product,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        SUM(premium) AS total_premium,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        ROUND(STDDEV(premium), 2) AS stddev_premium,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN product = 'HOME' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_product_home
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT row_count, adjuster_id, product, total_premium
    FROM totals
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(total_premium)
    FOR product IN ('AUTO', 'LIFE', 'HOME')
)
```

```python
    df_claims.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_policies.alias("p"),

        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "left",
    )

        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",
```

```sql
    FROM base
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,

        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, session_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS reading_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.quality IS NOT NULL) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS reading_quality_count
    FROM sessions s

    duration_min,

    reading_quality_count,

FROM summarized_rows
```

```python
)
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_tracks
    .filter((F.size(F.col("moods")) >= 2) & (F.col("bpm") >= 76))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
    )
)

artist_id_stats = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(F.avg("bpm").alias("avg_bpm"))
)

vs_group = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(artist_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.artist_id") == F.col("s.artist_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.bpm") > F.col("g.avg_bpm"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_bpm",

    )
)

filtered_2 = (

    .crossJoin(vs_group.agg(F.min("bpm_minus_avg").alias("overall_min_bpm_minus_avg")))
```

```sql
        SUM(prior_score_1d) OVER (ORDER BY prior_score_1d ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prior_score_1d_sum_7
    FROM in_window
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

)
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned_enrollments

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        term,
        burst_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,

        SUM(score) AS session_score,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY term, burst_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE session_score > (SELECT AVG(session_score) FROM session_summary)
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE session_score > (SELECT MIN(session_score) FROM without_matches)
)

    term,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_score,
    COALESCE(term, 'UNKNOWN') AS term_or_unknown
```

```python
cleaned_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("course_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.to_date(F.col("enrolled_at")).alias("enrolled_at_date"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

session_summary = (

)

result = (

    .filter(F.col("burst_id") <= 4)

        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "event_count",
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        is_skipped,
        source,
        FLOOR(ms_played / 50000) * 50000 AS ms_played_bucket
    FROM plays
    WHERE ms_played <= 221269
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous played_at per listener_id
    SELECT *, LAG(played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_played_at
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR played_at > prev_played_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        listener_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listener_id, session_no
),
detail_rows AS (
    -- One row per play
    SELECT
        s.listener_id,
        s.session_no,
        s.session_start,
        s.event_count,
        s.duration_min,
        p.id AS play_id,
        p.track_id AS play_track_id,
        p.ms_played AS play_ms_played
    FROM session_summary s
    JOIN plays p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
)
SELECT
    listener_id,
    play_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ROUND(STDDEV(play_ms_played), 2) AS stddev_play_ms_played,
    ROUND(STDDEV(event_count), 2) AS stddev_event_count
FROM detail_rows
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((listener_id, play_id), (listener_id), (play_id), ())
```

```sql
    FROM tracks
```

```python
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
    FROM claims
```

```sql
combined AS (

    SELECT 'claim' AS origin, id, reported_at
    FROM recent_claims
    WHERE status_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND policy_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT 'claim_2' AS origin, policy_id AS id, reported_at
    FROM claims
```

```python
        "claim_type",
        "claimed_amount",
        "reported_at",
        F.concat(F.col("status"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("status_ref"),
    )
)

    recent_claims
    .filter((F.col("status_ref").isNotNull()) & (F.col("policy_id").isNotNull()))
```
