```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_dims = (
    df_inventory
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p2"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("p2.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p2.city").isin(["Berlin", "Singapore"]))
    .select("s.*", F.col("p2.store_name"), F.col("p2.opened_date"), F.col("p2.region"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "last_restock",
        "store_name",
        "opened_date",
        F.avg("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("region", "product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("quantity_avg_2_prior"),
        F.lag("quantity", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("opened_date"), "product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id")).alias("product_id_sum_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lead("quantity", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id")).alias("next_quantity"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-10")))
    .withColumn("seq_no_num", F.col("seq_no").cast("double"))
)

with_dims_inventory = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.last_restock",
        "s.store_name",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.prev_quantity",
        "s.product_id_sum_quantity",
        "s.seq_no",
        "s.next_quantity",
        "s.seq_no_num",
        F.col("d.store_name").alias("store_store_name"),
        F.col("d.city"),
    )
)

with_windows_inventory = (
    with_dims_inventory
    .withColumn("prev_quantity_avg_2_prior", F.avg("prev_quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)))
    .withColumn("seq_no_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("store_id_max_product_id_sum_quantity", F.max("product_id_sum_quantity").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "city")))

)

    )
)
```

```sql
    ROUND(SUM(session_id_2) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/search' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS session_id_2_per_search,
    BIT_OR(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_or,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE page = '/product') AS product_rows
FROM with_dims
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time)
HAVING checkout_duration_sec < 1000000
ORDER BY checkout_duration_sec DESC NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-07-11").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("duration_sec") * 100), 2).alias("adjusted_duration_sec"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_id_2", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

ranked = (
    islands
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    ranked
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.device"), F.col("p.country"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "event_time").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/checkout", F.col("duration_sec")).otherwise(0)).alias("checkout_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.sum("session_id_2") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/search", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("session_id_2_per_search"),
        F.bit_or("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_or"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1)).alias("product_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("checkout_duration_sec") < 1000000)
    .orderBy(F.col("checkout_duration_sec").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
),
with_activity AS (

    FROM prepared_claims s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1

),

    -- Keep the latest row per claim_type, policy_id
    SELECT

        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        status_claim_type_label
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_type, policy_id ORDER BY claimed_amount DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM with_activity
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (

        *,

    FROM latest_per_key
    WINDOW w_adjuster_id_claim_type AS (PARTITION BY adjuster_id, claim_type)
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', claim_date) AS days_since_claim_date,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(status_claim_type_label), ' ', '_')) AS status_claim_type_label_slug,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(claim_type), 1, 3) AS claim_type_prefix
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
```

```sql
tagged AS (

        voltage_tier,
        kwh_tier
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM tagged
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(voltage) OVER (ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_voltage,
        SUM(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality) AS quality_sum_kwh,
        MIN(voltage) OVER (ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_voltage_so_far,
        FIRST_VALUE(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY voltage DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_kwh
    FROM latest
)

    site_id,
    quality_len,

FROM metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((site_id, quality_len, voltage_tier), (site_id), (quality_len))
ORDER BY site_id NULLS LAST, quality_len NULLS LAST, voltage_tier NULLS LAST
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN artists a ON a.id = t.artist_id

        listener_id,
        track_id,

        device,
        artist_genre,

        SUM(track_bpm) OVER w_track_id_artist_genre AS track_id_artist_genre_sum_track_bpm,
        LAST_VALUE(track_bpm) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(played_at), is_skipped ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_track_bpm,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY artist_genre, track_id ORDER BY played_at NULLS LAST, id), 3) AS played_at_cume_dist,
        LEAD(ms_played, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY played_at NULLS LAST, id) AS next_ms_played,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at), listener_id) AS rows_in_played_at_month_listener_id
    FROM enriched_track
    WINDOW w_is_skipped AS (PARTITION BY is_skipped), w_track_id_artist_genre AS (PARTITION BY track_id, artist_genre)

    FROM per_group
    WINDOW w_track_id AS (PARTITION BY track_id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    track_id,
    seq_no,
    next2_track_bpm_avg_7_device_phone,
    n_artist_genre_in_hiphop_pop_j,
    track_id_sum_seq_no,

    CASE WHEN track_id_sum_seq_no >= 65 THEN 'large' WHEN track_id_sum_seq_no >= 21 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS track_id_sum_seq_no_tier
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date

    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY policy_id

outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,

        ROUND(s.prior_rows_30d - g.avg_prior_rows_30d, 2) AS prior_rows_30d_minus_avg
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN policy_id_stats g ON g.policy_id = s.policy_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_30d > g.avg_prior_rows_30d
),
enriched AS (

        po.risk_score AS holder_risk_score
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id

FROM enriched
```

```python
valid = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "phone")
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("device"), F.col("source")).alias("device_source_label"),
        F.concat(F.col("device"), F.lit("#"), F.col("listener_id").cast("string")).alias("device_ref"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "device_source_label",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("device_source_label")), " ", "_")).alias("device_source_label_slug"),
    )
)

play_stats = (
    df_plays
    .groupBy("listener_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("played_at").alias("first_played_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("play_count"),
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_skipped"), 1)).alias("play_is_skipped_count"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    annotated.alias("s")
    .join(play_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "p.first_played_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.play_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("play_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.play_is_skipped_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("play_is_skipped_count"),
    )
)

listener_id_stats = (
    summarized_rows
    .groupBy("listener_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("play_count", 0.5).alias("median_play_count"))
)

vs_group = (
    summarized_rows.alias("s")
    .join(listener_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.play_count") >= F.col("g.median_play_count"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_play_count",
        F.round(F.col("s.play_count") - F.col("g.median_play_count"), 2).alias("play_count_minus_median"),
    )
)

scored = (
    vs_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("is_skipped"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_skipped_label"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("play_count_minus_median"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("play_count_minus_median_filled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .crossJoin(scored.agg(F.max("play_is_skipped_count").alias("overall_max_play_is_skipped_count")))
    .filter(F.col("play_is_skipped_count") < F.col("overall_max_play_is_skipped_count"))
    .drop("overall_max_play_is_skipped_count")
)

stats = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("is_skipped_label", "play_count", "is_skipped")
    .agg(
        F.min("first_played_at").alias("first_first_played_at"),
        F.round(F.avg("play_count_minus_median"), 2).alias("avg_play_count_minus_median"),
        F.round(F.sum("play_count_minus_median_filled") / F.nullif(F.sum("play_count_minus_median"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("play_count_minus_median_filled_to_play_count_min"),
        F.max("play_is_skipped_count").alias("max_play_is_skipped_count_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_play_is_skipped_count_check") > 2)
    .drop("max_play_is_skipped_count_check")
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "is_skipped_label",
        "play_count",
        "is_skipped",
        "first_first_played_at",
        "avg_play_count_minus_median",
        "play_count_minus_median_filled_to_play_count_min",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("is_skipped_label"))).alias("is_skipped_label_len"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM combined_details_site s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.read_at_quintile > g.avg_read_at_quintile

        m.voltage AS reading_voltage
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN meter_readings m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("quality").isin("EST", "OK")) & (F.col("kwh") <= 96.8))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("read_at")).alias("days_since_read_at"),
        (F.floor(F.col("kwh") / 25) * 25).alias("kwh_bucket"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("voltage", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_voltage"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("read_at_quintile"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh_bucket") - F.avg("kwh_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("quality")), 2).alias("kwh_bucket_vs_quality_avg"),
        F.sum("kwh_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("quality")).alias("quality_sum_kwh_bucket"),
    )
)

combined_details_site = (
    with_windows.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("si.installed_kw") <= 386.6)

        "s.*",
        F.col("si.installed_kw").alias("site_installed_kw"),
        F.col("si.tariff").alias("site_tariff"),
        "si.site_name",
    )
)

site_id_stats = (
    combined_details_site
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.avg("read_at_quintile").alias("avg_read_at_quintile"))
)

outliers = (
    combined_details_site.alias("s")
    .join(site_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.read_at_quintile") > F.col("g.avg_read_at_quintile"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_read_at_quintile",
        F.round(F.col("s.read_at_quintile") - F.col("g.avg_read_at_quintile"), 2).alias("read_at_quintile_minus_avg"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.voltage",
        "s.quality",
        "s.days_since_read_at",
        "s.kwh_bucket",
        "s.quality_sum_kwh_bucket",
        "s.site_name",
        "s.read_at_quintile_minus_avg",
        F.col("m.id").alias("reading_id"),
        F.col("m.quality").alias("reading_quality"),
        F.col("m.kwh").alias("reading_kwh"),
        F.col("m.read_at").alias("reading_read_at"),
        F.col("m.voltage").alias("reading_voltage"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_children
    .groupBy("site_id", "reading_read_at")
    .pivot("quality", ["OK", "EST"])
    .agg(F.min("reading_voltage").alias("min_v"), F.sum("reading_voltage").alias("sum_v"))
)
```

```sql
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.opened_date <= s.signup_date
            ORDER BY c.opened_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        clean_segment
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, account_status ORDER BY age) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1

with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching session per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT

        s.city,
        s.is_active,

        top1.session_device,
        top1.session_started_at

remaining_keys AS (

reconciled AS (
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
agent_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_3d per agent_id
    SELECT agent_id, AVG(prior_rows_3d) AS avg_prior_rows_3d
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_3d - g.avg_prior_rows_3d, 2) AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg
    FROM covered s
    JOIN agent_id_stats g ON g.agent_id = s.agent_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_3d > g.avg_prior_rows_3d
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        avg_prior_rows_3d,
        prior_rows_3d_minus_avg,
        prior_rows_3d - LAG(prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS prior_rows_3d_change,
        prior_rows_3d_minus_avg - LAG(prior_rows_3d_minus_avg) OVER w_prior_rows_3d_by_prior_rows AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
        SUM(avg_prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_prior_rows_3d_sum_3_prior
    FROM outliers
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_3d_by_prior_rows AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
totals AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'A' WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= -3.2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at) AS opened_at_month,
        ROUND(SUM(prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change), 2) AS total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
        MAX(opened_at) AS last_opened_at,
        MIN(opened_at) AS first_opened_at
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'A' WHEN prior_rows_3d_minus_avg >= -3.2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at)
    HAVING SUM(prior_rows_3d_change) > -5
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_tier,
    opened_at_month,
    total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change,
    last_opened_at
FROM totals
ORDER BY total_prior_rows_3d_minus_avg_change DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```sql
        artist_id,

    FROM tracks

),

    -- Max moods_count per duration_sec_tier
    SELECT duration_sec_tier, MAX(moods_count) AS max_moods_count
    FROM base_tracks
    GROUP BY duration_sec_tier
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_moods_count,
        ROUND(s.moods_count - g.max_moods_count, 2) AS moods_count_minus_max
    FROM base_tracks s
    JOIN duration_sec_tier_stats g ON g.duration_sec_tier = s.duration_sec_tier
    WHERE s.moods_count = g.max_moods_count
),
track_stats AS (
    -- Per-artist tracks metrics
    SELECT
        artist_id,
        SUM(duration_sec) AS total_track_duration_sec,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_explicit = FALSE) AS track_is_explicit_count
    FROM tracks
    GROUP BY artist_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach tracks metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.total_track_duration_sec,
        COALESCE(t.track_is_explicit_count, 0) AS track_is_explicit_count
    FROM vs_group s
    LEFT JOIN track_stats t ON t.artist_id = s.artist_id
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(TRIM(title)) AS title_clean,
        LENGTH(TRIM(title)) AS title_len,
        SIZE(moods) AS moods_count_2
    FROM with_stats
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        duration_sec_tier,
        YEAR(release_date) AS release_date_year,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(title)) AS title_list,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(title)) >= 7 THEN moods_count_minus_max ELSE 0 END) AS moods_count_minus_max_length_trim_title_7,
        COUNT(DISTINCT duration_sec_tier) AS distinct_duration_sec_tiers
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    duration_sec_tier,
    release_date_year,
    title_list,
    moods_count_minus_max_length_trim_title_7,
    distinct_duration_sec_tiers
FROM stats
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base_tracks = (
    df_tracks
    .filter((F.col("artist_id").isNotNull()) & (F.array_contains(F.col("moods"), "workout")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        "moods",
        F.concat(F.col("title"), F.lit("#"), F.col("bpm").cast("string")).alias("title_ref"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 344, "HIGH").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 213, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("duration_sec_tier"),
        F.size(F.col("moods")).alias("moods_count"),
    )
)

duration_sec_tier_stats = (
    base_tracks
    .groupBy("duration_sec_tier")
    .agg(F.max("moods_count").alias("max_moods_count"))
)

vs_group = (
    base_tracks.alias("s")
    .join(duration_sec_tier_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.duration_sec_tier") == F.col("s.duration_sec_tier"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.moods_count") == F.col("g.max_moods_count"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_moods_count",
        F.round(F.col("s.moods_count") - F.col("g.max_moods_count"), 2).alias("moods_count_minus_max"),
    )
)

track_stats = (
    df_tracks
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("duration_sec").alias("total_track_duration_sec"),
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_explicit"), 1)).alias("track_is_explicit_count"),
    )
)

with_stats = (
    vs_group.alias("s")
    .join(track_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.artist_id") == F.col("s.artist_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "t.total_track_duration_sec",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.track_is_explicit_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("track_is_explicit_count"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    with_stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("title"))).alias("title_clean"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("title"))).alias("title_len"),
        F.size(F.col("moods")).alias("moods_count_2"),
    )
)

stats = (
    annotated
    .groupBy("duration_sec_tier", F.year("release_date").alias("release_date_year"))
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("title")).alias("title_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.length(F.trim(F.col("title"))) >= 7, F.col("moods_count_minus_max")).otherwise(0)).alias("moods_count_minus_max_length_trim_title_7"),
        F.countDistinct("duration_sec_tier").alias("distinct_duration_sec_tiers"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "duration_sec_tier",
        "release_date_year",
        "title_list",
        "moods_count_minus_max_length_trim_title_7",
        "distinct_duration_sec_tiers",
    )
)
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") != "OUTBOUND")
    .select(

        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "operator",

        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("move_type")), " ", "_")).alias("move_type_slug"),
    )
)

w_all_by_qty = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "id")
w_move_type_operator = Window.partitionBy("move_type", "operator")
windowed = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("qty_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "id")).alias("qty_rank"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_all_by_qty).alias("qty_quartile"),
        F.lead("qty", 3, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("move_type").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_minus_qty").desc(), "id")).alias("next3_qty"),
        F.sum("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_id")).alias("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty"),
        F.min("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("unit_price_minus_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_qty_so_far"),
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price_minus_qty").over(w_move_type_operator), 2).alias("move_type_operator_avg_unit_price_minus_qty"),
        F.lead("qty", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("unit_price_minus_qty", "id")).alias("next2_qty"),
    )
)

w_sku_id_move_type_by_unit_pri = Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "move_type").orderBy("unit_price_minus_qty")
ranked = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("qty_quartile", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty_avg_3"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_sku_id_move_type_by_unit_pri).alias("unit_price_minus_qty_dense_rank"),
        F.first("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("qty_quartile", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty"),
        F.round(F.col("unit_price_minus_qty") - F.avg("unit_price_minus_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id")), 2).alias("unit_price_minus_qty_vs_warehouse_id_avg"),
    )
)

totals = (
    ranked
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("move_type")).alias("move_type_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("operator") == "op_dew", F.col("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty")).otherwise(0)).alias("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty_operator_op_dew"),
        F.percentile_approx("next2_qty", 0.5).alias("median_next2_qty"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("operator").alias("distinct_operators"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "sku_id",
        "move_type_list",
        "warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty_operator_op_dew",
        "median_next2_qty",
        "cnt",
        "distinct_operators",
        F.coalesce(F.col("cnt"), F.lit(0)).alias("cnt_filled"),
        (F.floor(F.col("distinct_operators") / 2) * 2).alias("distinct_operators_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("warehouse_id_sku_id_sum_qty_operator_op_dew").asc(),
        F.col("distinct_operators").asc(),
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM joined
```

```sql
sessions_subscriptions AS (

    FROM flagged
```

```sql
    SUM(median_claimed_amount_vs_distinct_adjuster_ids_a) AS amount, COUNT(median_claimed_amount_vs_distinct_adjuster_ids_a) AS n
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_claims = df_claims.filter(F.col("claimed_amount") >= 5313.8)

rollup_base = (
    scoped_claims
    .groupBy("claim_type", F.year("reported_at").alias("reported_at_year"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("approved_amount").alias("total_approved_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("claimed_amount", 0.5).alias("median_claimed_amount"),
        F.countDistinct("adjuster_id").alias("distinct_adjuster_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("n_rows") >= 3)
)

qualified = (
    rollup_base
    .crossJoin(rollup_base.agg(F.max("n_rows").alias("overall_max_n_rows")))
    .filter(F.col("n_rows") < F.col("overall_max_n_rows"))
    .drop("overall_max_n_rows")
)

with_windows = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("n_rows", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_adjuster_ids", "claim_type").orderBy(F.col("total_approved_amount").desc(), "claim_type", "reported_at_year").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_n_rows"),
        F.first("total_approved_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_adjuster_ids", "claim_type").orderBy(F.col("total_approved_amount").desc(), "claim_type", "reported_at_year").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_total_approved_amount"),
        F.sum("distinct_adjuster_ids").over(Window.partitionBy("reported_at_year", "n_rows").orderBy(F.col("n_rows").desc(), "claim_type", "reported_at_year").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("distinct_adjuster_ids_sum_6_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("median_claimed_amount") - F.avg("median_claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_adjuster_ids")), 2).alias("median_claimed_amount_vs_distinct_adjuster_ids_a"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("reported_at_year")
    .pivot("claim_type", ["theft", "collision", "flood"])
    .agg(F.sum("median_claimed_amount_vs_distinct_adjuster_ids_a").alias("amount"), F.count("median_claimed_amount_vs_distinct_adjuster_ids_a").alias("n"))
```

```sql
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM policies

    SELECT
        s.*,

        ROUND(s.premium - g.avg_premium, 2) AS premium_minus_avg
    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN product_stats g ON g.product = s.product
    WHERE s.premium > g.avg_premium
),
with_details_holder AS (

    SELECT

        s.holder_id,

        s.end_date,

        s.end_date_plus_365d,
        s.days_start_date_to_end_date,
        s.premium_minus_avg,
        p.holder_name,
        p.region AS holder_region
    FROM vs_group s
    LEFT JOIN policyholders p ON p.id = s.holder_id
)

FROM (
    SELECT id, premium, premium_minus_avg
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at") < F.lit("2025-02-12 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
```

```sql
FROM (
    SELECT claim_date, adjuster_id, status, approved_amount
    FROM profiled
) src
```

```sql
    -- Scope the stock_moves rows
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        qty,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        ABS(qty - 230) AS qty_distance
    FROM stock_moves
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous moved_at per operator
    SELECT *, LAG(moved_at) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_moved_at IS NULL OR moved_at > prev_moved_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        operator,
        burst_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY operator, burst_id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY burst_id ORDER BY n_events, operator, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        MIN(n_events) OVER (PARTITION BY n_events, burst_id) AS n_events_burst_id_min_n_events,
        ROUND(AVG(n_events) OVER (PARTITION BY burst_id ORDER BY n_events, operator, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS n_events_avg_3_prior
    FROM sessions
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sequenced
    WHERE running_count > (SELECT AVG(running_count) FROM sequenced)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT session_start, session_end, operator, n_events
    FROM with_activity
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(n_events)
    FOR operator IN ('op_bee', 'op_ann', 'op_eve', 'op_dew')
)
ORDER BY session_start, session_end
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_stock_moves
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.abs(F.col("qty") - 230).alias("qty_distance"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_moved_at", F.lag("moved_at").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("moved_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_moved_at").isNull() | (F.col("moved_at") > F.col("prev_moved_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("operator").orderBy("moved_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("operator", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("moved_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("moved_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("moved_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("burst_id").orderBy("n_events", "operator", "burst_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.min("n_events").over(Window.partitionBy("n_events", "burst_id")).alias("n_events_burst_id_min_n_events"),
        F.round(F.avg("n_events").over(Window.partitionBy("burst_id").orderBy("n_events", "operator", "burst_id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("n_events_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    sequenced
    .crossJoin(sequenced.agg(F.avg("running_count").alias("overall_avg_running_count")))
    .filter(F.col("running_count") > F.col("overall_avg_running_count"))
    .drop("overall_avg_running_count")
)

result = (
    with_activity
    .groupBy("session_start", "session_end")
    .pivot("operator", ["op_bee", "op_ann", "op_eve", "op_dew"])
    .agg(F.sum("n_events"))
    .orderBy("session_start", "session_end")
)
```

```sql
    -- Filter enrollments
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per student_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM base_enrollments
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(score) AS session_score,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_no
),
line_level_enrollments AS (
    -- One row per enrollment
    SELECT
        s.student_id,
        s.session_no,
        s.session_start,
        s.session_end,
        e.id AS enrollment_id,
        e.course_id AS enrollment_course_id,
        e.score AS enrollment_score
    FROM session_summary s
    JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.score BETWEEN 5.6 AND 76.8
),
summary AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        enrollment_id,
        MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
        ROUND(SUM(session_no) / NULLIF(SUM(enrollment_score), 0), 3) AS session_no_to_enrollment_score_ratio,
        ROUND(STDDEV(enrollment_score), 2) AS stddev_enrollment_score,
        MIN(session_no) AS min_session_no,
        SUM(session_no) AS total_session_no,
        MAX(session_end) AS last_session_end
    FROM line_level_enrollments
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    enrollment_id,
    first_session_start,
    session_no_to_enrollment_score_ratio,
    stddev_enrollment_score,
    min_session_no,
    total_session_no,
    last_session_end,
    HOUR(last_session_end) AS last_session_end_hour
FROM summary
ORDER BY last_session_end DESC, enrollment_id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

with_prev = base_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("student_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("score").alias("session_score"),

    .select(

        "s.session_no",
        "s.session_start",
        "s.session_end",
        F.col("e.id").alias("enrollment_id"),
        F.col("e.course_id").alias("enrollment_course_id"),
        F.col("e.score").alias("enrollment_score"),
    )
)

summary = (
    line_level_enrollments
    .groupBy("enrollment_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("session_start").alias("first_session_start"),
        F.round(F.sum("session_no") / F.nullif(F.sum("enrollment_score"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("session_no_to_enrollment_score_ratio"),
        F.round(F.stddev("enrollment_score"), 2).alias("stddev_enrollment_score"),
        F.min("session_no").alias("min_session_no"),
        F.sum("session_no").alias("total_session_no"),
        F.max("session_end").alias("last_session_end"),
    )
)

result = (

        "first_session_start",
        "session_no_to_enrollment_score_ratio",
        "stddev_enrollment_score",
        "min_session_no",
        "total_session_no",
        "last_session_end",
```

```sql
        id,
        category,
        weight_kg,
        labels,

    -- Derive helper columns

    FROM filtered

),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        labels,
        sku_code_clean,
        unit_cost_bucket,
        category_len,

        ABS(category_len - 6) AS category_len_distance,
        GREATEST(unit_cost_bucket, category_len) AS greatest_unit_cost_bucket_category_len
    FROM tagged
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT id, measure, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, greatest_unit_cost_bucket_category_len, category_len
    FROM derived
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR measure IN (greatest_unit_cost_bucket_category_len, category_len)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_skus
    .filter(~F.col("is_active"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "weight_kg",
        "labels",
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("sku_code"))).alias("sku_code_clean"),
        (F.floor(F.col("unit_cost") / 50) * 50).alias("unit_cost_bucket"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("category"))).alias("category_len"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("weight_kg").between(1.8, 15.2))
    .select(
        "id",
        "labels",
        "sku_code_clean",
        "unit_cost_bucket",
        "category_len",
        F.greatest(F.col("weight_kg"), F.col("unit_cost_bucket")).alias("greatest_weight_kg_unit_cost_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("category").isin("Apparel", "Electronics"), "group_a").when(F.col("category") == "Beauty", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("category_group"),
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("category"))).alias("category_clean"),

derived = (
```

```sql
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

        grade_status,
        burst_id,

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY grade_status, burst_id
),
metrics AS (

    SELECT

screened AS (

    FROM metrics
    WHERE burst_id > (SELECT AVG(burst_id) FROM metrics)

    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    session_end_month_min_duration_min,
    session_end_seq,
    ROUND(duration_min * 1.07, 2) AS duration_min_adj
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("score") > 6.2)
    .select(

        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.round(F.col("score") * 1.1, 2).alias("score_adj"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("grade_status", "burst_id")
    .agg(

    .drop("overall_avg_burst_id")
)

result = (

        "session_end",
        "event_count",
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
)
SELECT

    student_id,
    GROUPING(prior_rows_7d) AS is_total_prior_rows_7d,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

in_window = (
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_7d"),

    )

)

    .agg(
```

```python
        F.max("opened_at").alias("session_end"),
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    COALESCE(b.pass_avg_score, 0) AS pass_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM fail_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN pass_monthly b
  ON a.enrolled_at_month = b.enrolled_at_month
ORDER BY enrolled_at_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

fail_monthly = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at").alias("enrolled_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("fail_count"),
        F.sum("score").alias("fail_total_score"),

    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at").alias("enrolled_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("pass_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("score"), 2).alias("pass_avg_score"),
    )
)

result = (
    fail_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(pass_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.enrolled_at_month") == F.col("b.enrolled_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.enrolled_at_month"), F.col("b.enrolled_at_month")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.fail_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("fail_count"),

        F.coalesce(F.col("b.pass_avg_score"), F.lit(0)).alias("pass_avg_score"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.fail_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.pass_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```python
    .alias("s")
```
```python
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    COALESCE(b.outbound_total_qty, 0) AS outbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```python
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
```

```sql
        s.artist_id,
        s.title,
        s.release_date,
        s.bpm,
        s.moods,
        s.has_party,
        s.title_clean,
        a.is_verified AS artist_is_verified,
        a.artist_name
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN artists a ON a.id = s.artist_id
),
artist_id_stats AS (
    -- Median bpm per artist_id
    SELECT artist_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(bpm, 0.5) AS median_bpm
    FROM with_parent
    GROUP BY artist_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.median_bpm, ROUND(s.bpm - g.median_bpm, 2) AS bpm_minus_median
    FROM with_parent s
    JOIN artist_id_stats g ON g.artist_id = s.artist_id
    WHERE s.bpm >= g.median_bpm

with_windows AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        artist_id,
        bpm,
        has_party,
        artist_is_verified,
        artist_name,
        median_bpm,
        bpm_minus_median,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY bpm_minus_median, id) AS bpm_minus_median_seq,
        LAG(bpm) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY bpm_minus_median, id) AS prev_bpm,
        NTH_VALUE(median_bpm, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY bpm_minus_median, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_median_bpm
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT
    bpm_minus_median_seq,
    artist_is_verified,
    ROUND(AVG(prev_bpm), 2) AS avg_prev_bpm,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(artist_name)) AS artist_name_list,
    ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN artist_is_verified = TRUE THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_artist_is_verified_true
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((bpm_minus_median_seq, artist_is_verified), (bpm_minus_median_seq), (artist_is_verified))
```

```python
        "s.has_party",
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

        burst_id,

    FROM sessionized

        CASE WHEN session_end_percent_rank >= 0.8 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN session_end_percent_rank >= 0.3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_end_percent_rank_tier
    FROM with_trends
```

```python
scoped = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        (F.col("read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("read_at_plus_30m"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | (F.col("read_at") > F.col("prev_read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (

    .groupBy("site_id", "burst_id")

        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),

with_trends = (

    )
)

labeled = (

    .select(

        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("session_start")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("session_end"))) / 3600, 1).alias("hours_session_end_to_session_start"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_min_sum_7") * 1.07, 2).alias("duration_min_sum_7_adj"),
        F.when(F.col("session_end_percent_rank") >= 0.8, "HIGH").when(F.col("session_end_percent_rank") >= 0.3, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("session_end_percent_rank_tier"),
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("event_at") >= F.lit("2025-02-06 11:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select("*", F.length(F.trim(F.col("actor"))).alias("actor_len"))
)

    tagged
    .groupBy("event_type_group")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("actor_len", 0.5).alias("median_actor_len"))
)

    .groupBy("actor")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("event_type").alias("distinct_event_types"),

    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 2)
```

```sql
    FROM plays
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
profiled AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.min_play_ms_played,
        COALESCE(p.play_count, 0) AS play_count,

    FROM filtered s

scored AS (
```

```python
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_sg").asc_nulls_first())

    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "TH")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("rating") * 0.85), 2).alias("rating_scaled"),
        F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_sg"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("city_clean"),
    )
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("rating_scaled").asc_nulls_last())))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "rating_scaled", "is_sg", "city_clean")
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("%Who%"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(

        F.when(F.col("is_sg_rounded_percent_rank") >= 0.78, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_sg_rounded_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.max("is_sg_cume_dist").alias("max_is_sg_cume_dist"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("rating_scaled_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_rating_scaled_percent_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
```

```sql
        s.claimed_amount_minus_max,
        c.id AS claim_id,
        c.reported_at AS claim_reported_at,
        c.claim_date AS claim_claim_date

screened AS (
```

```sql
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id ORDER BY kwh, id), 3) AS kwh_cume_dist
    FROM in_window
```

```sql
    a.rejected_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM rejected_by_policy a
FULL OUTER JOIN open_by_policy b
  ON a.policy_id = b.policy_id
ORDER BY policy_id
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count_minus_inbound_count
```

```python
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("site_id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")).alias("voltage_decile"),
        F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality")).alias("site_id_quality_sum_kwh"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("kwh").desc_nulls_first())).alias("kwh_dense_rank"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")).alias("voltage_quintile"),
        (F.col("voltage") - F.lag("voltage").over(Window.orderBy("kwh", "id"))).alias("voltage_change"),

        F.nth_value("kwh", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_kwh"),
        F.sum("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_voltage"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("voltage")), 3).alias("voltage_percent_rank"),
    )
)

w_quality_voltage_decile_by_ru = Window.partitionBy("quality", "voltage_decile").orderBy("running_voltage", "id")
windowed = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",

        "quality",
        "quality_ref",
        "voltage_decile",

        F.max("voltage_decile").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "voltage_decile").orderBy("running_voltage", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("voltage_decile_max_3_prior"),
```

```sql
        agent_id,
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_priority_csat_by_csat AS (PARTITION BY priority, csat ORDER BY csat DESC, id)
),
channel_stats AS (
    -- Avg prev_csat per channel
    SELECT channel, AVG(prev_csat) AS avg_prev_csat
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY channel
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prev_csat,
        ROUND(s.prev_csat - g.avg_prev_csat, 2) AS prev_csat_minus_avg
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN channel_stats g ON g.channel = s.channel
    WHERE s.prev_csat > g.avg_prev_csat
),
with_children_events AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.closed_at,
        s.csat,
        s.prev_csat,
        s.csat_percent_rank,
        t.id AS event_id,
        t.actor AS event_actor,
        t.event_type,
        t.event_at
    FROM compared s

    prev_csat,
    csat_percent_rank,
    event_id,
    event_actor,

FROM with_children_events
```

```sql
with_windows AS (

        reading_quality_count,
```

```sql
WITH paid_monthly AS (
    -- PAID rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS paid_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'PAID'
```

```sql
),
open_monthly AS (

    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    a.paid_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.paid_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM paid_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN open_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

paid_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "PAID")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("paid_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("paid_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

open_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("open_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    paid_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(open_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.claim_date_month") == F.col("b.claim_date_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.paid_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("paid_count"),
        F.col("a.paid_avg_claimed_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.col("b.open_total_claimed_amount"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.paid_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("claim_date_month")
)
```

```sql
    WHERE su.team = 'VIP'
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(csat_per_requester_id / NULLIF(SUM(csat_per_requester_id) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id), 0), 4) AS csat_per_requester_id_share_of_agent_id,
        LAG(requester_id) OVER w_priority_len_agent_hired_on AS prev_requester_id,
        MAX(requester_id) OVER (PARTITION BY priority_len, YEAR(agent_hired_on) ORDER BY requester_id ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS requester_id_max_6_prior,

        ROUND(AVG(priority_len) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(agent_hired_on) ORDER BY closed_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS priority_len_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(csat_per_requester_id / NULLIF(SUM(csat_per_requester_id) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_team, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', agent_hired_on)), 0), 4) AS csat_per_requester_id_share_of_agent_team_agent_,

        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY priority_len, agent_id ORDER BY closed_at DESC), 3) AS closed_at_cume_dist
    FROM with_details_agent
    WINDOW w_priority_len_agent_hired_on AS (PARTITION BY priority_len, YEAR(agent_hired_on) ORDER BY requester_id ASC NULLS LAST, id), w_agent_hired_on_month_by_clos AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(agent_hired_on) ORDER BY closed_at ASC, id)
),

        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY closed_at DESC, id), 3) AS closed_at_cume_dist_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY closed_at_seq, priority_len ORDER BY priority_len, id) AS rn,

        MAX(closed_at_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY closed_at_seq, priority_len) AS closed_at_seq_priority_len_max_closed_at_cume_di,
        LAG(last_known_requester_id, 3) OVER (ORDER BY csat_per_requester_id_share_of_agent_team_agent_, id) AS prev3_last_known_requester_id
    FROM sequenced
```

```sql
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
    GROUP BY adjuster_id

    FROM claims

    GROUP BY adjuster_id
)

    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) AS approved_count,
    COALESCE(a.approved_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS approved_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    b.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS approved_count_minus_rejected_count
FROM approved_by_adjuster a
FULL OUTER JOIN rejected_by_adjuster b
  ON a.adjuster_id = b.adjuster_id
ORDER BY adjuster_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

approved_by_adjuster = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "APPROVED")
    .groupBy("adjuster_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("approved_count"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("approved_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

rejected_by_adjuster = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "REJECTED")
    .groupBy("adjuster_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rejected_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("rejected_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    approved_by_adjuster.alias("a")

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.adjuster_id"), F.col("b.adjuster_id")).alias("adjuster_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("approved_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_total_claimed_amount"), F.lit(0)).alias("approved_total_claimed_amount"),

        F.col("b.rejected_avg_claimed_amount"),

    )
```

```python
        (F.col("premium") - F.lag("premium").over(w_status_by_start_date)).alias("premium_change"),
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join listeners
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_3d,
        l.username AS listener_username,
        l.country AS listener_country
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN listeners l ON l.id = s.listener_id AND UPPER(TRIM(l.username)) LIKE 'C%'
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        listener_country,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_3d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_3d,
        MAX(played_at) AS last_played_at,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listener_id) AS distinct_listener_ids,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(listener_username)) AS listener_username_list
    FROM with_parent
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
    listener_country,
    cnt,
    stddev_prior_rows_3d,
    distinct_listener_ids,
    listener_username_list,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(listener_country), ' ', '_')) AS listener_country_slug,
    TO_DATE(last_played_at) AS last_played_at_date
FROM grouped
ORDER BY listener_country
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

in_window = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_plays.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_3d"),
    )
)

with_parent = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(df_listeners.alias("l"), (F.col("l.id") == F.col("s.listener_id")) & (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("l.username"))).like("C%")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.prior_rows_3d",
        F.col("l.username").alias("listener_username"),
        F.col("l.country").alias("listener_country"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_parent
    .groupBy("listener_country")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_3d"), 2).alias("stddev_prior_rows_3d"),
        F.max("played_at").alias("last_played_at"),
        F.countDistinct("listener_id").alias("distinct_listener_ids"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("listener_username")).alias("listener_username_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 3)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "listener_country",
        "cnt",
        "stddev_prior_rows_3d",
        "distinct_listener_ids",
        "listener_username_list",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("listener_country")), " ", "_")).alias("listener_country_slug"),
        F.to_date(F.col("last_played_at")).alias("last_played_at_date"),
    )
    .orderBy("listener_country")
)
```

```python
w_warehouse_id_by_qty = Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id").orderBy("qty", "id")
w_warehouse_id_sku_category = Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_category")

        F.round(F.col("qty") - F.avg("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_category")), 2).alias("qty_vs_warehouse_id_sku_category_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "sku_category")), 2).alias("warehouse_id_sku_category_avg_unit_price"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_warehouse_id_by_qty).alias("qty_tercile"),

    )
)

w_all_by_warehouse_id_sku_cate = Window.orderBy("warehouse_id_sku_category_avg_unit_price", "id")

ranked = (

        F.last("moved_at_year", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("qty_tercile").orderBy("n_operator_not_in_op_eve_op_an", "moved_at_year", "qty_tercile").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_moved_at_year"),

result = (
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,

        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_listener_id_by_prior_rows_3d_2, 3) AS prior_rows_3d_percent_rank,
        LEAD(prior_ms_played_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_3d, listener_id ORDER BY prior_rows_3d, id) AS next_prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM joined_ranges
    WINDOW w_listener_id_by_prior_rows_3d_2 AS (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, HOUR(played_at) AS played_at_hour
    FROM sequenced
    WHERE minutes_since_prev_played_at > 1500.0
),
listener_id_stats AS (
    -- Max minutes_since_prev_played_at per listener_id
    SELECT listener_id, MAX(minutes_since_prev_played_at) AS max_minutes_since_prev_played_at
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY listener_id
),

    FROM enriched s
    JOIN listener_id_stats g ON g.listener_id = s.listener_id
    WHERE s.minutes_since_prev_played_at = g.max_minutes_since_prev_played_at
```

```python
    )

with_windows = (

        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at")).orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc())).alias("voltage_rank"),
        F.lead("read_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at")).orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_read_at"),
        (F.col("voltage") - F.lag("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at")).orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id"))).alias("voltage_change"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("kwh_tier", "site_id").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("kwh_avg_6_prior"),

    )
)

top_rows = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("voltage_rank") == 1)
    .drop("voltage_rank")
)

per_group = (
    top_rows
    .groupBy(
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.outbound_avg_qty, 0) AS outbound_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count_minus_outbound_count
```

```sql
    SELECT site_id, COUNT(*) AS bad_count, SUM(kwh) AS bad_total_kwh
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'BAD'
    GROUP BY site_id
),
ok_by_site AS (
    -- OK rows per site_id
    SELECT site_id, COUNT(*) AS ok_count, ROUND(AVG(kwh), 2) AS ok_avg_kwh
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'OK'
    GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.site_id, b.site_id) AS site_id,
    COALESCE(a.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    a.bad_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.ok_count, 0) AS ok_count,
    COALESCE(b.ok_avg_kwh, 0) AS ok_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.bad_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.ok_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM bad_by_site a
FULL OUTER JOIN ok_by_site b
  ON a.site_id = b.site_id
ORDER BY site_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

bad_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "BAD")
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("bad_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("bad_total_kwh"))
)

ok_by_site = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "OK")
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("ok_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh"), 2).alias("ok_avg_kwh"),
    )
)

result = (
    bad_by_site.alias("a")
    .join(ok_by_site.alias("b"), F.col("a.site_id") == F.col("b.site_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.site_id"), F.col("b.site_id")).alias("site_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.bad_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_count"),
        F.col("a.bad_total_kwh"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_avg_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_avg_kwh"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.bad_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.ok_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("site_id")
)
```

```sql
    -- Scope the enrollments rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at,
        LENGTH(TRIM(grade_status)) AS grade_status_len,
        CASE WHEN grade_status IN ('FAIL', 'PASS') THEN 'group_a' WHEN grade_status = 'INCOMPLETE' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS grade_status_group
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE enrolled_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-24 09:00:00'
),
grouped AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        grade_status_group,
        ROUND(STDDEV(score), 2) AS stddev_score,
        ROUND(SUM(score) / NULLIF(SUM(grade_status_len), 0), 3) AS score_to_grade_status_len_ratio,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS first_enrolled_at,
        COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS distinct_student_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(score, 0.5) AS median_score,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM filtered_enrollments
    WHERE grade_status_len < 12
    GROUP BY 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM grouped
    WHERE median_score > (SELECT AVG(median_score) FROM grouped)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(distinct_student_ids) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status_group) AS grade_status_group_max_distinct_student_ids,
        distinct_student_ids - LAG(distinct_student_ids) OVER (ORDER BY stddev_score, grade_status_group) AS distinct_student_ids_change,
        MAX(median_score) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status_group) AS grade_status_group_max_median_score,
        MIN(median_score) OVER w_grade_status_group AS grade_status_group_min_median_score,
        ROUND(n_rows - AVG(n_rows) OVER w_grade_status_group, 2) AS n_rows_vs_grade_status_group_avg
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_grade_status_group AS (PARTITION BY grade_status_group)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT distinct_student_ids, grade_status_group, grade_status_group_max_median_score
    FROM ranked
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(grade_status_group_max_median_score)
    FOR grade_status_group IN ('other', 'group_a', 'group_b')
)
ORDER BY distinct_student_ids
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at") < F.lit("2025-02-24 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("grade_status"))).alias("grade_status_len"),
        F.when(F.col("grade_status").isin("FAIL", "PASS"), "group_a").when(F.col("grade_status") == "INCOMPLETE", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("grade_status_group"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    filtered_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status_len") < 12)
    .groupBy("grade_status_group")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("score"), 2).alias("stddev_score"),
        F.round(F.sum("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("grade_status_len"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("score_to_grade_status_len_ratio"),
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("first_enrolled_at"),
        F.countDistinct("student_id").alias("distinct_student_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("score", 0.5).alias("median_score"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    grouped
    .crossJoin(grouped.agg(F.avg("median_score").alias("overall_avg_median_score")))
    .filter(F.col("median_score") > F.col("overall_avg_median_score"))
    .drop("overall_avg_median_score")
)

w_grade_status_group = Window.partitionBy("grade_status_group")
ranked = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("distinct_student_ids").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status_group")).alias("grade_status_group_max_distinct_student_ids"),
        (F.col("distinct_student_ids") - F.lag("distinct_student_ids").over(Window.orderBy("stddev_score", "grade_status_group"))).alias("distinct_student_ids_change"),
        F.max("median_score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status_group")).alias("grade_status_group_max_median_score"),
        F.min("median_score").over(w_grade_status_group).alias("grade_status_group_min_median_score"),
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") - F.avg("n_rows").over(w_grade_status_group), 2).alias("n_rows_vs_grade_status_group_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy("distinct_student_ids")
    .pivot("grade_status_group", ["other", "group_a", "group_b"])
    .agg(F.sum("grade_status_group_max_median_score"))
    .orderBy("distinct_student_ids")
)
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.month(F.col("read_at")).isin(1, 2))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_hour"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id")))
```

```sql
        LAST_VALUE(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_voltage,
        LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id ORDER BY kwh, id) AS prev_read_at,
        NTH_VALUE(read_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id ORDER BY kwh, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_read_at,
        LAST_VALUE(kwh) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_kwh
    FROM base

    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(second_read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_read_at_to_second_read_at,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(read_at_label), ' ', '_')) AS read_at_label_slug
    FROM ranked
    WHERE read_at_label IS NOT NULL
),
```

```sql
        level,
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned

),
valid_employees AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LENGTH(email) AS email_length
    FROM valid
    WHERE dept_id IN (2, 14, 24)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        salary,
        job_title_filled,
        MAX(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id) AS dept_id_max_salary,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY email_length NULLS LAST) AS email_length_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(email_length, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY email_length, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_email_length,
        LAG(email_length, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY email_length, id) AS prev_email_length,
        SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY email_length, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_salary
    FROM valid_employees
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE job_title <> 'Manager'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_id,
    salary,
    job_title_filled,
    dept_id_max_salary,
    last_known_email_length,
    cumulative_salary
FROM verified
ORDER BY cumulative_salary
```

```python
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("email").like("%@yahoo.com"))

        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("job_title_filled"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("level").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "salary",

    .withColumn("email_length", F.length("email"))
)

enriched = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "salary",
        "job_title_filled",

verified = (

    .alias("s")

    .select("s.*")
)

result = (

    .select(

        "dept_id",
        "salary",
        "job_title_filled",
        "dept_id_max_salary",
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,

        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,

        SUM(csat) AS session_csat,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_no
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        YEAR(session_end) AS session_end_year,
        COALESCE(session_csat, 0) AS session_csat_filled,
        TO_DATE(session_start) AS session_start_date
    FROM session_summary
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        YEAR(session_start_date) AS session_start_date_year,

        MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end
    FROM annotated

    HAVING SUM(session_end_year) > 2024
)
-- Final projection
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_tickets
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "csat",
        "tags",
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("opened_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_opened_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("agent_id", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("opened_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("opened_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),

        F.min("session_start").alias("first_session_start"),
        F.max("session_start").alias("last_session_start"),
        F.min("session_end").alias("first_session_end"),
        F.sum("session_end_year").alias("sum_session_end_year_check"),
    )
```

```python
        F.avg("product_stock_qty").over(w_recent).alias("city_avg_product_stock_qty"),
    )
```

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.resolved_count, 0) AS resolved_count,

ORDER BY ticket_id
```

```python
        F.min("product_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_product_id"),
        F.count("product_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_product_id"),
        F.sum("product_id").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_product_id"),
        F.lag("product_id", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "created_at"), "customer_id").orderBy("position", "id", "position")).alias("prev_product_id"),

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy("product_id", "id", "position")).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "position",
        "running_min_product_id",
        "running_count_product_id",
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (

        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, burst_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE event_count > (SELECT AVG(event_count) FROM session_summary)
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM qualified
    WHERE burst_id > (SELECT AVG(burst_id) FROM qualified)
)

    session_end,
    event_count,
```

```python
    df_ticket_events
    .select(

        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("event_type")), 1, 3).alias("event_type_prefix"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_event_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("actor", "burst_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),

without_matches = (
```

```sql
    FROM islands

sessionized AS (

)
```

```python
        F.percentile_approx("event_count", 0.5).alias("median_event_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)

w_all_by_row_count = Window.orderBy("row_count", "session_start_ym", "event_count")

    .select(
        "session_start_ym",
        "event_count",
        "max_duration_min",
        "total_event_count",
        "row_count",
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_row_count), 3).alias("row_count_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("row_count")).alias("row_count_rank"),

    .select(
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL

    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
)

    CASE WHEN session_id_2 >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS session_id_2_tier,
    event_type,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(page)) AS num_pages,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'search') AS search_rows
FROM sessions_web_events
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING search_rows >= 1;
```
