    FROM flagged

        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY device_or_unknown, session_no
)
-- Final projection

    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,

        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,

        SUM(b.kwh) AS prior_kwh_7d

     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM matched
    WHERE prior_kwh_7d > (SELECT AVG(prior_kwh_7d) FROM matched)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        read_at,
        prior_kwh_7d,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_kwh_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS prior_kwh_7d_avg_7,
        ROUND(prior_rows_7d - AVG(prior_rows_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id), 2) AS prior_rows_7d_vs_site_id_avg,

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at ASC, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at

metrics AS (

        *,

        LAG(read_at) OVER (ORDER BY rows_in_site_id, id) AS prev_read_at,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY minutes_since_prev_read_at ASC, id), 3) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at_percent_rank,
        rows_in_site_id - LAG(rows_in_site_id) OVER (ORDER BY minutes_since_prev_read_at ASC, id) AS rows_in_site_id_change
    FROM windowed
    WINDOW w_all_by_rows_in_site_id AS (ORDER BY rows_in_site_id, id)

        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",

    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")

        id,
        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        LENGTH(TRIM(product)) AS product_len,

    FROM policies

    -- Median premium per status
    SELECT status, PERCENTILE_APPROX(premium, 0.5) AS median_premium
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY status
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_premium,
        ROUND(s.premium - g.median_premium, 2) AS premium_minus_median
    FROM recent s
    JOIN status_stats g ON g.status = s.status
    WHERE s.premium >= g.median_premium
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        status,
        holder_id,
        ROUND(SUM(premium_minus_median) / NULLIF(SUM(product_len), 0), 3) AS premium_minus_median_to_product_len_ratio,
        MAX(end_date) AS last_end_date,
        MIN(premium_minus_median) AS min_premium_minus_median,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROUND(AVG(premium), 2) AS avg_premium,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(product)) AS product_list
    FROM above_average
    GROUP BY status, holder_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT cnt, status, avg_premium
    FROM rollup_base
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(avg_premium)
    FOR status IN ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')
)
ORDER BY cnt

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_policies
    .filter(F.col("holder_id") >= 3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("product"))).alias("product_len"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("status"), F.col("product")).alias("status_product_label"),
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("status"), F.col("product")).alias("status_product_label_2"),
    )
)

status_stats = (
    recent
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("premium", 0.5).alias("median_premium"))
)

above_average = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(status_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.status") == F.col("s.status"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.premium") >= F.col("g.median_premium"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_premium",
        F.round(F.col("s.premium") - F.col("g.median_premium"), 2).alias("premium_minus_median"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    above_average
    .groupBy("status", "holder_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("premium_minus_median") / F.nullif(F.sum("product_len"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("premium_minus_median_to_product_len_ratio"),
        F.max("end_date").alias("last_end_date"),
        F.min("premium_minus_median").alias("min_premium_minus_median"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium"), 2).alias("avg_premium"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("product")).alias("product_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 2)
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .groupBy("cnt")
    .pivot("status", ["EXPIRED", "CANCELLED"])
    .agg(F.sum("avg_premium"))
    .orderBy("cnt")
)

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
grouped AS (

        MAX(event_at) AS last_event_at,
        SUM(CASE WHEN actor = 'agent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_actor_agent,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actor IN ('system', 'agent') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_actor_in_system_agent,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.5) AS median_burst_id,
        MIN(is_new_session) AS min_is_new_session,
        SUM(is_new_session) AS total_is_new_session
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY 1
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,

    FROM grouped

)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    total_is_new_session,
    median_burst_id,
    min_is_new_session,
    GROUPING(total_is_new_session) AS is_total_total_is_new_session,
    MIN(is_new_session) AS min_is_new_session_2,
    MIN(pct_actor_in_system_agent) AS min_pct_actor_in_system_agent
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((total_is_new_session, median_burst_id, min_is_new_session), (total_is_new_session), (median_burst_id), ())

with_stats = (

    .join(claim_stats.alias("c"), F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",

    df_meter_readings
    .select(

        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("OK", "BAD"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "EST", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("quality_group"),
        F.date_format(F.col("read_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("read_at_label"),
    )
)

with_parent_site = (
    filtered_readings.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.voltage",
        "s.quality",
        "s.quality_group",
        "s.read_at_label",
        F.col("si.zone").alias("site_zone"),
        F.col("si.tariff").alias("site_tariff"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    with_parent_site
    .filter(F.col("voltage") >= 214.3)
    .groupBy("site_zone", "site_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("site_zone").alias("distinct_site_zones"),
        F.round(F.sum("kwh"), 2).alias("total_kwh"),
        F.round(F.stddev("voltage"), 2).alias("stddev_voltage"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("site_zone").isNotNull(), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_site_zone_is_not_null"),
        F.sum("voltage").alias("sum_voltage_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_voltage_check") > 216.8)
    .drop("sum_voltage_check")
)

windowed = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "site_zone",
        "site_id",
        "distinct_site_zones",
        "total_kwh",
        "stddev_voltage",
        "pct_site_zone_is_not_null",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_site_zones").orderBy(F.col("total_kwh").desc(), "site_zone", "site_id")).alias("total_kwh_decile"),
        F.sum("distinct_site_zones").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")).alias("site_id_sum_distinct_site_zones"),
    )
)

line_level = (

    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), (F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id")) & (F.col("m.read_at") < F.lit("2025-02-24 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "left")

        F.col("m.quality").alias("reading_quality"),
    )

    line_level
    .cube("reading_quality", "site_zone")

    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS net_count

FULL OUTER JOIN car_by_listener b

    FROM sessionized

    COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    COALESCE(b.fail_avg_score, 0) AS fail_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.fail_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_student a

    SUM(voltage_distance) AS total_voltage_distance
FROM with_parent
GROUP BY ROLLUP(site_zone, quality_group, quality)
ORDER BY site_zone NULLS LAST, quality_group NULLS LAST, quality NULLS LAST

        ticket_id,

    FROM ticket_events

    FROM filtered

    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_event_at)) / 60 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (

        actor,
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, session_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP

    events,
    COALESCE(actor, 'ALL') AS actor,
    session_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM sessions
GROUP BY ROLLUP(events, actor, session_id)
ORDER BY events NULLS LAST, actor NULLS LAST, session_id NULLS LAST

SELECT
    COALESCE(a.track_id, b.track_id) AS track_id,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) AS desktop_count,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_avg_ms_played, 0) AS desktop_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS car_count,
    b.car_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS desktop_count_minus_car_count
FROM desktop_by_track a
FULL OUTER JOIN car_by_track b
  ON a.track_id = b.track_id
ORDER BY track_id
```

    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "desktop")

    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', paid_at) AS paid_at_period,
        CASE WHEN method IN ('paypal', 'bank_transfer') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS method_group
    FROM payments
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'

),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.method,
        a.amount,
        a.paid_at,
        a.method_group,
        b.amount AS order_amount
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),

    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(order_amount) OVER w_grp AS order_amount_count_7d,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount, id) AS amount_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount,
        SUM(order_amount) OVER w_recent AS cumulative_order_amount
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE order_amount BETWEEN 510 AND 1020
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM metrics
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
metrics_payments AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT

        LEAD(is_new_burst) OVER w_part AS next_is_new_burst,
        LAG(amount_bucket) OVER w_part AS prev_amount_bucket,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS event_seq
    FROM sessionized

latest AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM metrics_payments
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY event_seq) = 1
)

    amount,
    paid_at,
    method_group,
    order_amount_count_7d,
    first_known_amount,

WITH matched AS (
    -- Events that happened while the ticket was open
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.ticket_id,
        e.event_at,

        t.agent_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e.event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.opened_at)) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_open
    FROM ticket_events e
    JOIN tickets t
      ON t.id = e.ticket_id
     AND e.event_at >= t.opened_at
     AND e.event_at <= COALESCE(t.closed_at, t.opened_at + INTERVAL 7 DAYS)
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at) AS event_at_month,
        ROUND(STDDEV(hours_since_open), 2) AS stddev_hours_since_open
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at)
)
SELECT
    event_at_month,
    stddev_hours_since_open,
    DATE_FORMAT(event_at_month, 'yyyy-MM') AS event_at_month_label
FROM stats
ORDER BY stddev_hours_since_open

        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"))),
        "inner",

    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,

        tw.rate,

    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    LEFT JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, YEAR(read_at) ORDER BY kwh DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS kwh_avg_3,
        SUM(energy_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(read_at), quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_energy_cost,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(read_at), quality ORDER BY read_at DESC) AS read_at_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(read_at), quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id) AS rn,
        FIRST_VALUE(kwh) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_kwh
    FROM covered
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        zone,
        rate,
        energy_cost,
        kwh_avg_3,
        running_energy_cost,
        rn,
        first_known_kwh
    FROM metrics
    WHERE read_at_rank <= 2
)

SELECT

    site_id,
    quality,
    zone,
    rate,
    rn,
    first_known_kwh,
    ABS(kwh_avg_3 - 42.0) AS kwh_avg_3_distance,
    CASE WHEN zone IN ('Z4', 'Z3') THEN 'group_a' WHEN zone = 'Z2' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS zone_group
FROM top_per_group
WHERE rate <= 5.7

        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))

        "site_id",
        "quality",
        "zone",
        "rate",
        "rn",
        "first_known_kwh",
        F.abs(F.col("kwh_avg_3") - 42.0).alias("kwh_avg_3_distance"),

    COALESCE(a.bad_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS net_count

        l.interests AS listener_interests,

        F.coalesce(F.col("quality"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("quality_or_unknown"),

site_id_stats = (

    FROM plays

    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

        session_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,

        SUM(ms_played) AS session_ms_played,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY track_id, session_id
)
SELECT
    track_id,
    session_id,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    session_ms_played
FROM per_session
ORDER BY n_events DESC

    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, v
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM lines
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        k,
        status_code_high,
        is_flagged
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k, level ORDER BY log_ts DESC, id ASC, k ASC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM flattened_attrs
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, k ASC) AS prev_log_ts
    FROM ranked
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_log_ts IS NULL OR log_ts > prev_log_ts + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessions_app_logs AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, k ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    k,
    status_code_high,
    prev_log_ts,
    is_new_session
FROM sessions_app_logs
ORDER BY is_new_session ASC NULLS FIRST
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    flattened_attrs
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("k", "level").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "k")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "log_ts", "k", "status_code_high", "is_flagged")
)

with_prev = ranked.withColumn("prev_log_ts", F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_log_ts").isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.col("prev_log_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_app_logs = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessions_app_logs
    .select("id", "k", "status_code_high", "prev_log_ts", "is_new_session")
    .orderBy(F.col("is_new_session").asc_nulls_first())
)

    FROM transactions

prev_events AS (

    FROM valid

gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_sum_amount,
        MAX(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, merchant) AS txn_type_max_session_start_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount, id) AS seq_no,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_start_flag_sum_30d,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY island_id) AS island_id_percent_rank
    FROM islands
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time - LAG(prev_txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY prev_txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_windows
),
islands_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY prev_txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY session_start_flag DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM islands_transactions
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    txn_type,
    txn_time,
    merchant,
    is_flagged,
    merchant_lower,
    prev_txn_time,
    session_start_flag,

    CASE WHEN merchant RLIKE '^(7-Eleven|Grab)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS merchant_zone
FROM deduped;

    df_transactions

)

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_txn_time").isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.col("prev_txn_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (

deduped = (
    islands_transactions
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session

        priority,

        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY priority, session_id
)

    event_count,
    priority,
    session_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(priority)) AS priority_list,

        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        status,

    FROM policies

status_stats AS (
    -- Avg premium per status
    SELECT status, AVG(premium) AS avg_premium
    FROM cleaned_policys
    GROUP BY status
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_premium,
        ROUND(s.premium - g.avg_premium, 2) AS premium_minus_avg
    FROM cleaned_policys s
    JOIN status_stats g ON g.status = s.status
    WHERE s.premium > g.avg_premium
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product,
        start_date,
        premium_tier,
        avg_premium,
        premium_minus_avg,
        COALESCE(avg_premium, 0.0) AS avg_premium_filled,
        COALESCE(product, 'UNKNOWN') AS product_or_unknown,
        premium_minus_avg - avg_premium AS premium_minus_avg_minus_avg_premium
    FROM outliers
    WHERE avg_premium BETWEEN 1160.0 AND 3320.0
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    COALESCE(product, 'ALL') AS product,
    COALESCE(product_or_unknown, 'ALL') AS product_or_unknown,
    COALESCE(premium_tier, 'ALL') AS premium_tier,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM tagged
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((product, product_or_unknown, premium_tier), (product), ())

    FROM filtered

    FROM enriched

        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per course_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        course_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_id, burst_id
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        course_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        ROUND(SUM(burst_id) / NULLIF(SUM(n_events), 0), 3) AS burst_id_to_n_events_ratio,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS distinct_course_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(n_events, 0.5) AS median_n_events
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY course_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start)
    HAVING SUM(n_events) > 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    course_id,
    session_start_month,
    burst_id_to_n_events_ratio,
    median_duration_min,
    last_session_start,
    distinct_course_ids,
    median_n_events,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', last_session_start) AS days_since_last_session_start
FROM per_group
ORDER BY median_n_events DESC NULLS FIRST

    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("course_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),

result = (

        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,

    FROM payments

        COALESCE(method, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_method
    FROM filtered
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        o.discount,
        o.status AS order_status,
        o.channel
    FROM islands a
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id <=> o.id
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
        CASE WHEN discount >= 0.41 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS discount_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT_IF(order_status = 'PENDING') AS pending_events,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(session_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS session_id_quartiles
    FROM with_dims
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at), CASE WHEN discount >= 0.41 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (CASE WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at)), (CASE WHEN amount >= 1500 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), ())

SELECT

    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,
        a.enrolled_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_12h
    FROM enrollments a
    LEFT JOIN enrollments b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        prior_rows_12h,
        prior_score_12h,
        LAG(prior_rows_12h) OVER w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor AS prev_prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(prior_score_12h) OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_score_12h_sum_2_prior,
        LEAD(prior_rows_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h ORDER BY prior_score_12h ASC, id) AS next_prior_rows_12h,
        prior_score_12h - LAG(prior_score_12h) OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC, id) AS prior_score_12h_change,
        ROUND(prior_rows_12h - AVG(prior_rows_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h, student_id), 2) AS prior_rows_12h_vs_prior_rows_12h_student_id_avg,
        ROUND(prior_rows_12h / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_12h) OVER w_prior_rows_12h_student_id, 0), 4) AS prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h ORDER BY prior_score_12h ASC, id), w_prior_rows_12h_student_id AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h, student_id)
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE prev_prior_rows_12h > (SELECT MIN(prev_prior_rows_12h) FROM ranked)
)
SELECT
    next_prior_rows_12h,
    prev_prior_rows_12h,
    prior_rows_12h,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM screened
GROUP BY CUBE(next_prior_rows_12h, prev_prior_rows_12h, prior_rows_12h)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

w_prior_rows_12h_student_id = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")
ranked = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "prior_rows_12h",
        "prior_score_12h",
        F.lag("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor).alias("prev_prior_rows_12h"),

        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_12h") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_student_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i"),
    )

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")

        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_3d"),

)

    joined_ranges.alias("s")
    .join(df_stock_moves.alias("st"), (F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.col("st.unit_price") < 289.7), "inner")
    .select(

FROM accounts a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM customers c
    WHERE a.customer_id = c.id
      AND c.signup_date > a.opened_date
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.plan <> 'basic'
      AND s.monthly_fee IS NULL
      AND a.customer_id = s.customer_id
)
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 5;

    FROM flagged

        move_type,
        DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_end_ym,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end,
        MAX(event_count) AS max_event_count,
        ROUND(SUM(session_no) / NULLIF(SUM(event_count), 0), 3) AS session_no_to_event_count_ratio,

    FROM cleaned_claims

    SELECT
        s.*,

        ROUND(s.approved_amount_plus_claimed_amount - g.avg_approved_amount_plus_claimed_amount, 2) AS approved_amount_plus_claimed_amount_minus_avg
    FROM cleaned_claims s

    FROM flagged
)

    course_id,
    burst_id,
    is_new_session,
    GROUPING(course_id) AS is_total_course_id,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(term)) AS term_list
